jobs.title: Program Manager, AI Agent & Support Automation
jobs.description:
Bullhorn's core purpose is to create an incredible customer experience, and the organization has a sharp focus on delivering very high quality products and services to its customers. The company culture is shaped by five Core Values: Ownership, Energy, Speed & Agility, Service, and Being Human. Each value, and its underlying definition, serves as a behavioral guide for employees as they interact with customers and fellow coworkers and is an embedded way of operating across our organization.

Bullhorn is a fast-paced and dynamic environment where hard work and outstanding results are rewarded and celebrated. We value those that exhibit an eagerness to learn and a strong natural desire for continuous improvement and we encourage team members to stretch themselves, acknowledge challenges and learn from them. With a strong focus on growth, we provide ample opportunities for career development and prioritize promoting from within. We believe that leaders should care deeply about the development of their employees at all levels, emphasizing emotional intelligence and accountability. Our leaders collaborate closely to ensure the success of their teams, and we work together to achieve shared goals, creating a challenging and rewarding workplace for everyone.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a builder role at the intersection of AI, customer experience, and operational excellence. You'll be the single accountable owner of Sophia, Bullhorn Support's customer-facing self-service AI agent (built on Salesforce Agentforce), driving measurable case deflection while keeping the customer experience excellent.

You'll inherit strong foundational tooling but will need to diagnose gaps, tune the agent, establish guardrails and governance, and build the measure-and-improve cadences that make self-service durable at scale. This role owns and tunes the system; it doesn't require building it from scratch or writing production code.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* End-to-end ownership of Sophia: configuration, prompting, performance, and success, including subagents, topics, actions, routing, escalation-to-case, and guardrails.
* Designing, testing, and iterating the prompts and instructions that drive the agent's behavior, tone, and accuracy, validated in sandbox with regression testing before every production release.
* Case deflection and containment targets: defining them, driving them, and reporting on them, while protecting CSAT.
* Production monitoring and QA: reviewing transcripts, tracking accuracy and drift, and catching regressions early.
* Guardrails, human-in-the-loop policies, and responsible-AI practices, with a rollback plan for every change.
* Connecting internal and external self-service, and representing Support's needs into Bullhorn's internal AI knowledge initiative.
Partnering across Support Operations, CX Data & Analytics, Enablement, and platform/vendor contacts, and providing executive-level updates on self-service performance.  

  

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 4+ years in support operations, customer experience, conversational/AI design, or a self-service/deflection role at a SaaS or technology company, including hands-on ownership of a self-service or AI support capability.
* Hands-on experience configuring, deploying, and tuning conversational AI agents in production (Agentforce strongly preferred), including Agent Script.
* Prompt engineering experience: designing, testing, and iterating prompts to improve accuracy and behavior.
* Proven case deflection results using self-service AI tooling, with the ability to use data and conversation analysis to evolve self-service over time.
* Salesforce Service Cloud (case management) and Experience Cloud (customer portal) experience. •
* Strong analytical skills, comfortable building dashboards/scorecards and translating metrics into recommendations.
* Excellent written communication, including executive-level summaries.
Ability to operate as an individual contributor while influencing across functions, with product/project and change management experience.  

  

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Salesforce Administrator and/or Agentforce Specialist certification.
* Low-code/scripting ability (Flow, APIs, JSON); builders and "vibe coders" welcome, production code not required.
* Familiarity with KCS/knowledge management and how article quality affects AI deflection.
* Experience with other AI-assisted support tools and BI/data-visualization tools (e.g., Snowflake, Tableau, Salesforce reports).
Background in staffing, HR tech, or enterprise SaaS, and experience supporting global teams across US and EMEA time zones.  

  

The annual base salary range for this position is $150,000. In addition, this role is eligible for a target bonus & a comprehensive benefits package

**Compensation and Transparency Statement**

The posted range represents the good-faith estimate of what we expect to pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual pay within the range will be based on factors such as, but not limited to, experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business or organizational needs and affordability. In accordance with state and local pay transparency laws we disclose salary ranges in all job postings and provide additional information upon request.

**What we offer...**

* Benefits eligibility effective DAY ONE including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), 401(k) Match, and more
* Unlimited Planned Paid Time Off
* Global Mental Health Support
* On-Demand Learning & Development
* Quarterly paid volunteer days
* Lucrative Employee Referral Program (eligible for prior to your first day)
* Company-wide mentor program

jobs.title: Project Manager, Community Veterinary Medicine Project
jobs.description:
Description:

Community medicine is an emerging veterinary discipline focused on expanding access to care for animals and the people who love them. It draws on both shelter medicine and private practice and is organized around principles such as spectrum of care, protocolled medicine, and task-shifting. The field is growing quickly, but it has no shared, authoritative body of guidance.

The Community Veterinary Medicine Project is a collaborative, multi-institution project, housed at the SF SPCA. It will be the first comprehensive, freely available resource for the veterinary field. Over 18 months, an Editorial Leadership Council (ELC) of five veterinary leaders, led by SF SPCA CEO, Dr. Jennifer Scarlett, will work with a national cohort of subject matter expert authors to produce four connected resources:

* **Clinical Guidelines** for veterinarians practicing community medicine
* **An Operations Manual** for launching and running community clinics
* **Clinical Decision Tools** designed for use in the exam room
* **A Research Database**, developed with UC Davis

The work follows a formal governance process with conflict-of-interest disclosure, an AI use policy, external peer review, and review by a Strategic Advisory Council.

You'll own day-to-day delivery of the project: the plan, the timeline, the budget tracking, and the pipeline that moves more than two dozen chapters from first draft to publication. You'll always know where things stand and what's at risk, and you'll bring problems to the Executive Sponsor, Dr. Jennifer Scarlett, early, with options.

This role suits someone who enjoys order, notices when something is about to fall through the cracks, and communicates clearly and warmly with senior professionals. Most of the people you'll work with are senior veterinary leaders who don't report to you and are fitting this work around demanding clinical careers. You don't need a veterinary background, but you do need to be comfortable learning a specialized vocabulary and applying written standards consistently.

The workload rises and falls. It peaks around the open call for authors, contributor onboarding, each convening, and final platform assembly. We'll plan schedules together so hours flex to meet those windows.

**Responsibilities**

*Own Project Plan and Timeline*

* Build and maintain the master project plan and timeline across all four deliverables.
* Spot schedule risks early and bring recovery options to the Executive Sponsor.
* Approve routine deadline extensions within agreed limits and escalate larger changes.
* Track spending against the grant budget and prepare progress and budget inputs for funder reports.
* Keep records that meet funder and governance documentation requirements at all times.

*Run the Governance Process*

* Keep the ELC moving: schedule meetings, set agendas, deliver pre-reads, and follow action items through to completion.
* Run the Strategic Advisory Council's two scope reviews, from distributing materials to consolidating feedback.

*Manage the Contributor Lifecycle and the Review Pipeline*

* Run the open call for authors and onboard selected contributors, making sure every conflict-of-interest disclosure, AI use attestation, and contributor agreement is on file before writing begins.
* Partner with the ELC chair to set and hold authors and reviewers to agreed deadlines.
* Log and organize incoming applications by topic for ELC review.
* Send author notifications and onboarding packets.
* Organize author orientation sessions, kickoff calls, and mid-point check-ins, including recordings for those who can't attend live.
* Maintain an accurate contributor roster with contact details, topic assignments, credentials, and affiliations.

*Track Manuscripts Through Review*

* Log each draft on receipt and run a first-pass check against the submission checklist. This covers file naming, required deliverables, figure files, and completed forms.
* Route drafts to the assigned Category Editor, and track feedback and revision deadlines at each governance stage.
* Manage external peer review logistics: send invitations, share materials, track reviewer agreements and deadlines, and collect comments.
* Keep the project tracker (Asana) and shared Google Drive folders current, so anyone can see where every chapter stands.

*Coordinate the In-Person Convenings*

* Plan two 2-3 day convenings (virtual or in-person), managing logistics, participant travel, and budget, and partner with the facilitator who leads the sessions.
* Process travel reimbursements and contributor stipends according to budget and policy.

*Lead Assembly and Launch*

* Compile contributor attribution, credentials, and COI disclosures for publication front matter.
* Manage final platform assembly by tracking files, version control, and outstanding items.
* Coordinate launch communications logistics, including author notifications and distribution of attribution language.

**Reporting Relationships and Contacts**

* Reports to the Senior Executive Assistant to the CEO; Executive Sponsor: CEO

Requirements:

* At least 3-5 years of project management, project coordination, executive support, or equivalent experience. Nonprofit, academic, association, healthcare, or publishing settings are especially relevant.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred
* Strong organizational skills and a track record of managing many parallel deadlines and people at once.
* Clear, professional, courteous written communication, including polite follow-up with senior professionals who may be slow to respond.
* High proficiency with Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets, Calendar) and video conferencing tools.
* Comfort designing systems others can use: trackers, shared folders, and templates that keep a team aligned.
* Experience with a project management tool such as Asana, Monday, Trello, or Smartsheet, or the ability to learn one quickly.

Formed by the merger of PharmaCord and Mercalis, Valeris™ revolutionizes the path from life sciences innovation to real-life impact to build a world in which every patient gets the care they need. Valeris works on behalf of life sciences companies to improve the patient experience so that patients can access and adhere to critical medications. Backed by proven industry expertise, a deep commitment to patient care, the latest technology, and exceptionally talented team members, Valeris provides the data and strategic insights, patient support services and healthcare provider engagement tools to help life sciences companies successfully commercialize new products. Valeris provides commercialization solutions to more than 500 life sciences customers and has provided access and affordability support to millions of patients. **Agile Project Manager I**

**DCHIPS Team – Senior Health Agile Release Train**
---------------------------------------------------

We are seeking an Agile Project Manager I to join the DCHIPS team within our Senior Health Agile Release Train (ART). This role is ideal for a highly organized Project Manager who enjoys keeping teams aligned, keeping work visible, and moving delivery forward in a collaborative Agile environment.

DCHIPS is a team of approximately 14 engineers, support specialists, and data specialists supporting two core enterprise data systems – DCH (Data Clearinghouse) and CPIS (Client Policy Information System), including its mainframe and web components – along with UDB and customer-facing APIs. The team balances ongoing production support with project and enhancement delivery and is working to automate and streamline day-to-day support so it can focus on modernizing these platforms. The team is distributed across multiple states.

As the team's Agile Project Manager, you will own daily support ticket intake and work management, project status reporting, and Agile planning, along with stakeholder communication and incident visibility. No two days are exactly alike.

##### **Who Are We?**

We at Movemedical make the world’s best software solution for medical device companies.

We're hiring a Senior Project Manager to own delivery of our strategic enterprise implementation programs for our medical device customer organizations. You’ll join our Professional Services team, working closely with our VP of Professional Services and Chief Customer Officer, with ownership over how these programs get run from day one.

We hire smart, tenacious people and give them the mentorship and opportunities they need to grow as team members and leaders. As a small company with big ambitions, we see and recognize the impact of every person on our team.

We are team-oriented and want each other to be successful; we pull together to accomplish our goals. Glassdoor gives us a 4.2/5.0 and Inc. put us on its Best Places to Work Editor’s List in 2019.

##### **Who Are You?**

You've either worked as a project manager inside a medical device or clinical organization, run large ERP or supply-chain implementations, or led enterprise-level SaaS implementations in the Life Sciences or Healthcare IT space. Either way, you speak the language of the clients we serve, and you bring real rigor to how you manage a program.

You’ve also worked somewhere fast-moving and not fully formal, and you know how to adapt your process to fit rather than importing a rigid framework. You don’t wait for internal clarity before acting with confidence. You hold the line on scope, timeline, and rigor with clients and with your own team, even while the environment around you is still being defined.

You’re comfortable being the senior voice in the room with a client, and just as comfortable pushing back internally when something isn’t set up to succeed. When a program starts heading toward real trouble, whether budget, timeline, or scope, you know when to handle it yourself and when to bring it to your manager, and you don’t wait until it’s unavoidable.

* You will run and maintain program status reporting, timelines, and risk/issue tracking, communicating clearly with both client and internal stakeholders

* You will act as the primary point of contact for client program stakeholders, representing Movemedical with the rigor and professionalism expected by med device and clinical organizations

* You will coordinate cross-functionally with Professional Services, Support, and Product teams to keep implementations on track

* You will build enough fluency in client-side technical and operational context, including inventory, supply chain, and clinical workflows, to be seen as credible by client stakeholders

This role translates approved growth opportunities into actionable project plans and drives execution from pre-close or initial planning through launch, stabilization, and transition to ongoing operations. The Project Manager coordinates cross-functional teams, maintains accountability for milestones and deliverables, identifies and escalates risks, and supports multiple concurrent projects while strengthening Altruix’s repeatable M&A and De Novo implementation processes.

**Launch Readiness and Continuous Improvement:**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

This Director-Level leadership role is responsible for translating strategic objectives into successful operational execution while ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction, technical excellence, workforce performance, financial stewardship, and program growth. **Technical Program Execution**

**Financial & Business Management (P&L Responsibility)**

* Monitor program financial health, including revenue, margin, labor utilization, backlog, burn rates, and cost performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability through operational efficiencies, workforce optimization, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Contracts, Finance, Program Controls, and Business Operations to manage budgets, forecasts and financial reporting.

**Customer Engagement**

* Develop trusted relationships with FAA leaders, Peraton executives, and key stakeholders.

* Ensure customer priorities remain aligned with program execution.
* Represent Peraton during executive-level meetings and strategic planning sessions.

**Risk, Compliance & Governance**

* Lead enterprise risk management activities across operational, technical, financial, and schedule performance.
* Drive quality assurance, operational governance, and continuous service improvement.
* Resolve complex technical, organizational, staffing, and customer issues.

##### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* U.S. Citizenship Required.

* Strong written, oral, stakeholder-management, analytical, and problem-resolution skills.

**Compensation**

**About the Business**
----------------------

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Government division, our solutions assist government agencies and law enforcement to drive insights from complex data sets, improving operation efficiency, increasing program integrity, discovering, and recovering revenue, and making timely and informed decisions to enhance investigations. You can learn more about LexisNexis Risk at the link below.

https://risk.lexisnexis.com/government

**About the Team**
------------------

The VitalIQ Product team is responsible for delivering scalable, high‑quality IT solutions that support business objectives and customer outcomes. The team partners closely with stakeholders across the organization to translate business needs into effective technology solutions, emphasizing collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**About the Role**
------------------

This entry‑level position partners with the VitalIQ Product team to support an assigned VitalIQ State, contributing to the delivery of IT solutions and services aligned with organizational cost, quality, and strategic goals. Working under the guidance of a Group Product Manager, this role focuses on business requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, validation, and testing of application features and functionality. The role also involves regular interaction with customers and stakeholders, requiring strong communication and relationship‑building skills.

  
  

This role can be remote in the US with minimal travel as needed. Hours may vary on occasion to support the client (CST most common)

  
  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Analyze and document basic business requirements and processes, including current‑state (As‑Is) and future‑state (To‑Be) workflows
* Assist in developing basic system specifications, process flows, and conversion strategies

* Create and maintain basic technical and functional user documentation
* Follow established business processes, protocols, and quality standards throughout solution development and deployment
* Support stakeholder and customer expectations, escalating risks or issues to project managers as appropriate
* Build trusted‑advisor relationships with stakeholders and customers through effective communication and reliable project execution
* Perform additional duties and ad hoc support as assigned

**Requirements**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience
* US Citizenship is required for this role.
* Basic understanding of software development methodologies, platforms, tools, and languages
* Familiarity with the software development life cycle (SDLC)
* Understanding of business requirements elicitation and documentation, including user stories and functional specifications
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
* Proficiency and previous work experience with Jira
* Ability to understand and document business processes and system workflows
* Moderate facilitation skills with the ability to collaborate across teams
* Basic oral and written communication skills
* Excellent attention to detail and willingness to learn in a structured, team‑oriented environment

jobs.title: Research Analyst
jobs.description:
**Summary**

Guidepost Solutions is seeking a full-time desktop Research Analyst to conduct complex open-source intelligence (OSINT) and public-record research in support of investigations, litigation, due diligence, and other client matters. The Research Analyst scopes research requests, identifies appropriate sources and methodologies, analyzes and verifies information, and prepares clear, accurate, client-ready work product. The role also supports project execution by coordinating assignments, tracking deadlines and project phases, maintaining organized matter files, communicating status and research limitations, and helping ensure timely, high-quality deliverables.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Conduct background investigations and other research assignments using OSINT techniques, public records, and approved research tools and databases, including TLO, IRB, CLEAR, PenLink, LexisNexis, and Westlaw.
* Scope research requests and identify appropriate sources, search strategies, and methodologies based on the client matter and project objectives.
* Conduct public-record research to locate civil, criminal, probate, regulatory, and administrative proceedings across multiple jurisdictions.
* Identify, collect, and analyze court records, corporate and business records, media, social media, and other relevant sources for credibility, timeliness, relevance, and significance.
* Verify identities, identify related entities and associates, and obtain information used to locate witnesses or other parties relevant to a client matter.
* Draft and finalize concise, clear, and comprehensive client-ready reports, chronologies, exhibits, source lists, and other supporting materials.
* Based on project scope, interview subjects and witnesses, coordinate technical support, and submit orders for document retrieval.
* Support business development and marketing efforts by researching companies, persons, or business areas
* Collaborate with researchers, investigators, and other project team members to exchange ideas, coordinate work, and strengthen findings.
* Perform work in accordance with applicable laws, licensing requirements, client instructions, contractual restrictions, database terms of use, and the Company’s ethical and professional standards, while remaining current on OSINT methods and database capabilities.
* Perform administrative tasks, including timekeeping, receipts, and invoices.
* Maintain the confidentiality of client and investigative information and follow applicable laws, database terms of use, and Company ethical standards.

**Competencies**

* Analytical and critical thinking, research judgment, and intellectual curiosity.
* Attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Time management, prioritization, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines with limited supervision.
* Collaboration, client service, responsiveness, and adaptability.
* Discretion, confidentiality, sound professional judgment, and ethical practice.
* Proficiency with research databases, Microsoft Office, and digital research, collaboration, and case-management tools.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Three (3) to five (5) years of OSINT and public-records research experience.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and working knowledge of digital research and collaboration tools.
* Experience locating, retrieving, and analyzing public records and using legal or investigative research databases.
* Demonstrated ability to assess source reliability, corroborate findings, identify inconsistencies, and document research methodology and citations.
* Strong writing, editing, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a private investigations firm, law firm, law-enforcement or government agency, corporate intelligence or compliance function, journalism organization, or professional-services environment.
* Experience researching corporate affiliations, ownership, assets, sanctions, regulatory matters, adverse media, or litigation histories.
* Experience preparing chronologies, exhibits, link analyses, or other investigative work product.

**Position Type/Expected Hours of Work**

This is a full-time, exempt position. Regular business hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Longer hours and after-hours responsiveness may be required for urgent client matters, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. The position follows a hybrid schedule based in the New York office, with an expectation of 3 days in-office days per week. The Company may modify work-location or schedule expectations based on business needs.

**Physical Requirements**

While performing the duties of this job, much of the work may be performed while sitting at a desk, using a computer, typing, handling calls and using standard office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift or move office products and supplies weighing up to 20 pounds.

**Other Duties**

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of all activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time, with or without notice.

**Compensation**

The base annual salary range offered for this position is based on numerous factors, including job-related skills and knowledge, experience, specific location, relevant education and/or training. In addition to the annual salary, we offer a full benefits package.

*Guidepost Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetic information or any other characteristic protected by law.*

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in CSSA, GICSP, GRID, CISSP, or equivalent.
* 10 years of experience in program or project management.
* 7 years of experience in a leadership role.
* Experience in risk management, and domain authority in OT Cybersecurity.
* Experience automating legacy workflows and migrating legacy systems onto centrally managed virtualization platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Engineering Management, or an MBA.
* 10 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Deep knowledge of Google Plan of Record (gPOR) infrastructure topologies, Purdue model compliance, or advanced zero-trust network architectures.
* Practical understanding of SCADA architectures, Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), and Facilities Network Routing.
* Sound understanding of vendor management, OpEx/CapEx budgets, and headcount allocation.
* Proficient at solving problems lacking clear precedent, leveraging thought leadership to translate broad corporate mandates into tactical, repeatable projects for field teams.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Infrastructure Development and Delivery (ID2) team designs, builds and operates gigawatts of reliable, efficient, flexible data centers around the world. Our data centers are the foundation of all Google services and infrastructure, from classic servers and networking to bespoke storage and advanced AI hardware. Google data centers lead the industry in efficiency and carbon footprint, and regularly introduce innovative new technologies and approaches for the ideal data center portfolio.

Google's Data Center Operations (DCOps) team acts as the stewards of the physical infrastructure that powers the world’s information. We operate the mechanical, electrical, and control systems that keep our servers running 24/7/365.

Data Center Central Ops is the global operational governance, engineering support, and business operations team, supporting efficient growth and operation of Google’s data center fleet.

As the Senior Program Manager for Data Center Physical Infrastructure Controls Security (PhysICS) and OT Health, you will lead the strategic operational programs keeping Infrastructure Development and Delivery (ID2) power and cooling engines running safely, securely, and reliably 24x7. You will be a People Manager responsible for hiring, coaching, and developing a globally distributed team of senior Technical Program Managers, Program Managers, and Operations Engineers.

You will act as the principal strategic liaison between Central Operations, Plant Engineering, local site teams, and security governance organizations, including Compliance, Strategy, and Risk Management (CSRM), Operational Technology Security (OTS) and Cloud CISO Security Engineering (CCSE). Your mission is to define the strategic roadmap to verifiably reduce cybersecurity risk on mission-critical Infrastructure Controls Security (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT), effectively hardening standard OT environments against IT-based threats.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $236000 - $329000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define, articulate, and execute the multi-year strategic roadmap for OT Health and PhysICS security hygiene, tailoring program priorities to anticipate emerging cybersecurity threats and business constraints.
* Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing, globally distributed team. Identify skill gaps, foster a culture, and enable community contributions across the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Direct programs auditing and monitoring data center OT equipment configurations, PLC updates, OTHP virtualization, and asset inventory completeness to proactively drive reliability and reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).
* Serve as the central operational custodian bridging communication pathways between upstream security and design teams (CCSE, CSRM) and downstream local operational stakeholders.
* Guide team through ambiguous, high-stakes, highly complex technical bottlenecks, leveraging data-driven insights to unblock migrations and maintain strict Security SLOs.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

CoreWeave is building the infrastructure that powers the next era of AI, at a pace and scale that demands operational excellence across every function. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to join the CIO organization and drive programs that connect Data Center Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT. You'll deliver the systems, integrations, and workflows that support predictable site expansion, trusted operational data, and reliable execution across CoreWeave.

**About the Role**
------------------

You will lead technical programs within Data Center Operations and across the functions that support the data center lifecycle. Your scope will span data center infrastructure management (DCIM), telemetry, asset management, lifecycle platforms, and their dependencies on procurement, inventory, financial systems, and IT.

You will connect workstreams into integrated plans, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and drive accountability from discovery through rollout and stabilization. The Technical Program Manager owns the integrated execution plan, delivery cadence, dependency and risk management, and readiness coordination. Business owners and the DC PMO own business requirements, approvals, and change management; Product Management owns product scope and acceptance criteria; Engineering owns technical design, implementation, testing, and technical support. You will bring these owners together to deliver agreed outcomes.

You will lead programs across multiple teams and functions, including interconnected initiatives across sites. You will resolve competing priorities with senior stakeholders, manage critical paths across programs, and establish delivery mechanisms adopted by multiple teams.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own integrated delivery plans for programs spanning Data Center Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT, with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and measurable outcomes.
* Connect site expansion and operational technology initiatives with procurement, equipment availability, inventory and asset records, financial processes, and IT readiness. Identify gaps between functional plans and drive decisions before they affect delivery.
* Drive DCIM deployment and site onboarding programs, coordinating asset data readiness, integrations, vendor commitments, testing, and operational handoffs to improve onboarding predictability.
* Partner with Facilities, Engineering, Data teams, and suppliers to improve telemetry coverage and data quality. Track monitoring gaps, alerting issues, and remediation through closure.
* Lead asset-system migrations and legacy-tool retirement, coordinating data reconciliation, downstream dependencies, cutover and rollback plans, and clear exit criteria.
* Coordinate delivery across lifecycle platforms, construction milestone integrations, enterprise systems, and operational dashboards, ensuring workflow and data changes remain consistent across functions.
* Maintain a unified view of program commitments, critical paths, risks, and decisions. Run effective planning and execution cadences, keep owners accountable, and escalate conflicts with clear options and recommendations.
* Maintain traceability from approved business requirements and product acceptance criteria through implementation, testing, and launch readiness. Ensure decisions and sign-offs come from the accountable owners.
* Orchestrate business UAT, go-live readiness, and operational handoffs. Coordinate with the DC PMO on training and communications and with Engineering on hypercare and support readiness, accounting for live-site constraints.
* Track outcomes such as predictable site onboarding, trusted asset and telemetry data, reliable integrations, adoption, and issue resolution. Build reusable plans, dashboards, and playbooks that improve execution across CoreWeave.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You have demonstrated delivery experience with a complex systems implementation or migration involving integrations, data readiness, testing, and operational handoff.
* You have experience leading technical programs across multiple business functions and can connect operational needs, enterprise systems, and technical delivery.
* You have strong fundamentals in integrated planning, critical-path analysis, dependency management, risk tracking, resource coordination, and driving decisions to closure.
* You can interpret system diagrams, APIs, integrations, data flows, migration approaches, and testing dependencies.
* You are familiar with data center operations and their connections to procurement, inventory, asset lifecycle, financial processes, and IT systems.
* You have practical experience using Agile, Scrum, or Kanban to manage delivery, with tools such as Jira and Asana.
* You have proven stakeholder-management experience across operational leaders, technical teams, business system owners, and external vendors, including resolving conflicting commitments and priorities.
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including concise executive updates that connect progress, risks, and decisions to business outcomes.
* You have demonstrated experience resolving priorities across senior stakeholders, managing dependencies across multiple programs, and establishing operating mechanisms used beyond your immediate team.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with Sunbird or other DCIM platforms

**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**About the Team**  
ServiceNow's Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering team is an entrepreneurial, fast-growing, fast-moving function at the center of ServiceNow's shift to AI-native. We sit at the front lines of the most strategic agentic engagements in the Fortune 500 - partnering directly with C-suite buyers to translate ambiguous business problems into production-grade agentic builds that move the needle on revenue, cost, and customer experience. Our central technical function ensures we're meeting market demand at pace, scaling without sacrificing production fidelity, and feeding the signals from frontier customer work back into the ServiceNow product ecosystem.

**About the Role**  
We're hiring a Principal, AI Deployment Strategy to own where the FDE organization deploys its talent for maximum impact. This role sits at the seam between our portfolio of engagements, our global capacity, and our critical GTM, sales, and product relationships. You'll calibrate how we allocate FDE resources against the highest-leverage customer, product, and market opportunities. This is a strategist-operator role, not a coordinator's - every deployment decision, every capacity constraint, every scale path is yours to solve at an expert caliber. The right person has lived across GTM, value technical value, and delivery, has the executive presence to hold a room with senior sales and product leadership.

**Who Thrives Here**  
Operator-builders who've sat in seats across GTM, value engineering, and delivery and want all three at once. Comfortable being the strategist in a GTM planning session on Monday and the deployment tactician solving capacity trade-offs on Tuesday. No ego about scope; deep ego about outcomes.

**What You'll Own**

**FDE Global Deployment & Portfolio Strategy**  
Own the global FDE portfolio and allocation strategy. Work with regional leadership, Geo Presidents, and SVP/GTM to calibrate where FDE delivers the most impact on revenue, product signal, and customer reference value. Run the investment thesis that positions the FDE team in the highest-conviction customer, product, and GTM moments. Navigate the competing priorities across regions, portfolios, and strategic accounts and make the calls that maximize team impact globally, not just locally.

**2. FDE Investment Strategy & ROI Operations**  
FDE capacity is scarce and expensive. Deploy it like capital.

* **Treat every FDE engagement as an investment.** Approve only work tied to a clear strategic imperative or commercial outcome: a renewal, net-new ACV, or a key product expansion. Set approval criteria that hold up under CFO scrutiny. Lock scope, success criteria, and the target outcome before work starts, then track every engagement through to the result.
* **Prove the return.** Measure the renewals, net-new ACV, consumption, and expansion influenced per FDE-week, by engagement type, region, and industry. Make sure every value case clears its cost to serve. Use the results to steer where FDE deploys next and when to scale headcount or extend through partner capacity.

**3. Value Velocity & Build Economics**  
Compress the time from use case identification to value defined, aligned to token burn, and executive-signed-off. Build the repeatable playbook that gets engagements from "interesting problem" to "approved investment with quantified outcomes" in a fraction of the current cycle. Scale that playbook across the portfolio so every FDE engagement benefits from the same velocity and rigor, regardless of region or industry.

**4. Evolving Initiatives & Scale Path Orchestration**  
Stay close to what's working in the portfolio and what's not. Own the emerging initiatives that define FDE's next frontier - agentic use cases, go-to-market motions, industry verticals, platform capabilities - and build the scale paths that turn early wins into portfolio-wide capability. Recognize when an initiative is ready to scale, when it needs more signal, and when it should be archived. Define and manage the partner motion that extends FDE reach without diluting caliber. Build the vetting standards, engagement model, and guardrails that let tier-1 SIs and specialist partners deliver on FDE-adjacent work under FDE brand and quality standards.

**5. Executive Narrative & Senior Relationship Alignment**  
Drive how the FDE impact shows up at the highest altitudes - board narratives, Financial Analyst Day, C-suite QBRs, marquee customer references. Own the throughline from raw deployment and build outcomes to the story that moves markets, analysts, and pipeline.

**6. The Charter Isn't Fixed - It's Ever-Evolving**  
The AI market shifts week to week. What resonated with customers last quarter may be table stakes today, and what's not working needs to be killed fast. Stay close enough to the field to read those signals in real time, and move mountains internally to make sure the team is leaning into what's landing and pulling back from what isn't. Pattern-match across the portfolio, find the highest-leverage deployment decision in any given week, and go solve it at an expert level. Comfort with ambiguity and speed is the price of entry.

jobs.title: Business Systems Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Business Systems Data Analyst**

**About JEM**

Founded in 1999, JEM is a privately held company that designs, manufactures and sells consumer electronics accessories, including charging and power products, cables, power banks, audio and smart home devices. We bring well-known licensed brands to market through some of the world's largest retailers, along with ecommerce, and distributors.

**The Opportunity**

JEM is investing in how we use data across the business, and we're looking for a Business Systems Data Analyst to help lead that work. Over the next year we're making two major system upgrades. We're moving our ERP from Sage to NetSuite, and we're moving product development into Centric PLM, so that development, sourcing, production and quality (QA/QC) all work from the same system and the same product data. On top of both, we're building internal tools and automated workflows that connect how products are developed with how they're sold. Each of these projects depends on clean, well-structured data, and that's where you come in.

This role is a good fit for someone early in their career who has strong SQL Server skills, an interest in the financial side of the business, and a desire for real ownership. You'll work directly with leadership, learn how a consumer products business runs end to end, and build things people use every day.

**What You'll Do**

**ERP data and migration**

* Learn our ERP data in Sage: how items, costs, orders, inventory, customers and financials are structured and connected
* Support our migration to NetSuite by mapping data between the two systems, cleaning it up, and validating the results after it moves
* Document data definitions and business rules so everyone works from the same numbers

**Financial analysis**

* Analyze performance across our business entities and sales channels, including B2B wholesale and ecommerce
* Build profitability views by entity, channel, customer and product, covering revenue, cost of goods, margin and the key cost drivers
* Partner with finance to reconcile operational data to the books and explain variances
* Turn financial results into clear insights that help leadership decide where to invest, adjust pricing, or cut costs

**Order and inventory flows**

* Map how customer orders move through our business, from EDI purchase orders received through TrueCommerce to fulfillment, shipment and invoicing
* Track warehouse inventory flows, including receipts, transfers, on-hand balances and shipments
* Build reporting that shows where orders and inventory stand, and flag delays, gaps or mismatches early

**Data tables and reporting**

* Build data tables from ERP, PLM and EDI data that give the business clear visibility into items, costs, inventory, orders, sales and profitability
* Set up automated data feeds into Microsoft SQL Server so reporting stays current without manual exports
* Create checks that catch data quality issues and keep numbers consistent across systems
* Prepare reliable, well-documented data for internal tools and automated workflows

**Business partnership**

* Work with finance, operations, supply chain, sales, product development and sourcing to understand their questions and turn them into data they can act on
* Learn the business behind the data, including how products are developed and costed, how orders are fulfilled, and how each channel makes money

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical, analytical or finance-related field, or equivalent experience
* 0–3 years of experience in data analysis, financial analysis or data engineering (internships and projects count)
* Strong Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures and views
* Working knowledge of Python for data work
* An understanding of relational databases and data modeling
* Comfort with core financial concepts like revenue, cost of goods, gross margin and the P&L
* Careful with details and clear when explaining your work to people who aren't technical
* Interested in learning the business, not just the tools

**Nice to Have**

* SSIS, SSMS, or SQL Server Agent jobs
* Google BigQuery
* ERP or PLM experience (Sage, NetSuite, Centric)
* EDI experience (TrueCommerce), including documents like purchase orders, advance ship notices and invoices
* Experience with warehouse or inventory data
* Financial modeling, multi-entity reporting, or experience with general ledger data
* Experience with ecommerce or marketplace data
* Experience working with APIs
* Background in consumer products, retail or supply chain

**Why This Role**

* Shape how data is used across the entire company
* Work directly with leadership and get real mentorship
* Gain broad exposure to finance, supply chain, operations and product development
* See how every part of the business connects, from product cost to channel profitability
* Room to grow as our data capabilities expand
* Healthcare and 401(k)

Pay: From $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Overview:

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) is the single accountable owner for delivering Kastle’s enterprise-platform programs and the complex, cross-functional technology work that runs alongside them. Reporting to the CIO, the TPM drives one unified plan, sequence, and cadence across every functional owner and implementation partner touching a program — from the ERP, CRM, CPQ, and HRIS rollouts through client integration deliveries.

Kastle’s Enterprise Technology Team is entering a concentrated window of platform work: a net-new ERP implementation, a CRM moving from selection into build, a live CPQ migration, and an HRIS improvement program. These programs have overlapping timelines, external implementation partners, and shared dependencies. The TPM is engaged at kickoff on any program that clears a defined complexity bar and stays accountable through go-live and into steady-state updates.

Responsibilities:

The programs you will own

**Platform**

**Scope of the work**

**ERP**

Net-new implementation with an external partner; migration off legacy financial systems; phased rollout across finance and operations.

**CRM**

Selection in final stages, moving directly into a net-new build and rollout; feeds downstream systems including CPQ.

**CPQ**

Live migration off the legacy platform (Expert Logic to Logik); parity work, experience enhancements, and Sales acceptance.

**HRIS**

Deployment of improvements and ongoing configuration and release management on the existing platform.

  
Qualifications:

These programs already intersect. For example, CPQ enhancement items are on hold pending CRM field definitions that the CRM program has not yet finalized. The TPM is the person who sequences dependencies like this deliberately, so they are planned rather than discovered late.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Enterprise platform delivery**
--------------------------------

* **Own deployment, configuration, and ongoing updates** across the enterprise platforms: ERP, CRM, CPQ, and HRIS, from kickoff through go-live and into steady-state release management.

* **Coordinate external implementation partners and internal functional owners** to a single plan, status, and risk view per program.
* **Run recurring cross-functional status reviews** across every owner on a given program, including vendors and partners.

**Client integration delivery**
-------------------------------

* **Own an end-to-end plan across client integration delivery** — install, integration, hardware, onboarding, and access — with a single point of accountability across workstreams.
* **Validate access as its own workstream** and confirm delivery-method and migration assumptions (for example, full export versus incremental) before they become execution risk.
* **Ensure source data and credential requirements are gathered before kickoff,** working from the scoping and requirements handed off by the paired Solutions Engineer function.

**Governance and risk**
-----------------------

* **Operationalize governance once adopted:** run RACI, rollback runbooks, and the Integration Review Board gate as live delivery mechanisms rather than paper artifacts.
* **Provide executive-ready reporting:** one authoritative status, risk, and dependency view per owned program, communicated directly to executive stakeholders and the CIO.

Other Eligibility Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 5+ years of technical program or project management delivering complex, cross-functional technology programs with multiple functional owners and external partners.
* Demonstrated experience owning enterprise software implementations end to end — one or more of ERP, CRM, HRIS, or CPQ — including partner management, configuration, data migration, and phased rollout.
* Track record as a single accountable owner sequencing dependencies across concurrent programs.
* Fluency with integration and identity/access concepts (provisioning, SCIM/Entra, data reconciliation) sufficient to challenge delivery-method, migration, and access assumptions early.
* Experience standing up and running delivery governance: RACI, status cadences, review/gate mechanisms, and rollback planning.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable driving reviews and reporting status directly to executive stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program-management credential.
* Direct experience implementing one or more of the platform categories on Kastle’s roadmap (ERP, CRM, CPQ, HRIS).
* Experience in physical security, IoT, hardware-plus-software, or managed-services delivery environments.
* Prior experience coordinating platform migrations and large data migrations across vendors.

**First-90-Day Success Measures**
=================================

* A named TPM is engaged on each in-flight enterprise-platform program that meets the complexity bar.
* A single cross-program plan exists, with dependencies between ERP, CRM, CPQ, and HRIS made explicit and sequenced.
* One authoritative status, risk, and dependency view exists for each owned program.
* RACI, rollback runbooks, and the Integration Review Board gate are operating on active programs where they have been adopted.

**Scope Boundaries**
====================

The TPM coordinates and operationalizes across enterprise rollouts and client delivery. The following sit outside this role:

* Source-system data quality, whether the source is a client system or an internal one.

* Vendor selection decisions themselves (for example, the CRM platform choice).

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst | Global Support | Hybrid | Reston, VA
jobs.description:
About Ellucian:

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.

About the Opportunity:

Are you looking to join an innovative team at a leading higher education technology company? If you’re passionate about Support Operations analytics and eager to build expertise in business intelligence, enterprise support tools, and global customer support data strategy, this role is for you!

As part of Ellucian’s Global Support organization, you’ll develop data assets, dashboards, and operational insights that enable informed decision-making across technical support, operations, and leadership teams.

As the **Business Intelligence Analyst** for Global Support, you’ll use Tableau, ServiceNow, Excel, and automation tools to deliver accurate and timely reporting. Working closely with Support leaders, you’ll refine BI solutions that improve customer outcomes, strengthen operational discipline, and enable faster, more informed decisions.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

* Develop and maintain dashboards and reporting tools to help Global Support and business leaders understand operational trends, including backlog, SLA performance, MTTA, MTTR, escalation volume, and case aging.
* Analyze support data by developing hypotheses, documenting assumptions, and identifying trends, relationships, contributing factors, and opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to define business questions, determine appropriate analytical approaches, and translate findings into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Deliver high-quality analyses, reports, and presentations using clear, accessible visualizations for operational and leadership audiences.
* Identify opportunities to streamline and automate recurring reporting processes while maintaining the accuracy, reliability, and usability of dashboards and data assets.

**What You Will Bring**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in business intelligence, support operations analytics, customer or technical support analytics, or a related role involving reporting and operational analysis.
* Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and analysis across multiple datasets; proficiency in PowerPoint.
* Experience with support or operations data, including case management, SLA performance, backlog, escalations, knowledge management, customer satisfaction, or related service delivery metrics.
* Experience building dashboards and generating insights using Tableau or a comparable business intelligence platform.
* Strong attention to detail, with a commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and reliable reporting maintenance.
* Ability to manage priorities independently, collaborate across teams, respond to time-sensitive needs, and constructively identify opportunities to improve existing approaches.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex questions and translate findings into practical action.
* Working knowledge of data extraction, validation, analytical methods, and interpretation techniques.
* Strong communication, presentation, and data-storytelling skills, with the ability to explain findings to varied audiences.

**Extra Credit**

* Experience with ServiceNow or another case-management platform.
* Interest in developing skills in predictive analytics, advanced analytics, or data science.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Commonwealth is seeking a Senior Data Analyst to support the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) in advancing programs and technologies that help drive groundbreaking research, improve public health outcomes, and support the Institute's critical mission.

In this role, you will work directly with federal leaders, researchers, program staff, technical teams, and stakeholders to improve business processes, optimize system operations, support application development efforts, and deliver solutions that enhance organizational effectiveness. You'll play a key role in bridging business needs with technology solutions while helping NHLBI modernize operations, improve user experiences, and enable data-informed decision making.

This position is ideal for a consultative leader who enjoys solving complex challenges, driving continuous improvement, and serving as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders in a mission-focused environment.

Why This Opportunity?

* Support one of the nation's leading biomedical research organizations.
* Help enable programs that contribute to advances in heart, lung, blood, and sleep health research.
* Work directly with federal stakeholders on high-visibility initiatives.
* Lead efforts that improve business operations, user experiences, and organizational effectiveness.
* Influence decisions and recommendations that shape future processes and technology solutions.
* Collaborate with functional, technical, and leadership teams in a highly mission-driven environment.

What You'll Do:

As the Senior Data Analyst, you will serve as a strategic liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams while helping ensure successful delivery of operational and technology initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze application data, reporting outputs, business rules, and system behavior to identify trends, resolve issues, and support informed decision-making.
* Support NHLBI’s data teams in providing key analysis on operations and budget.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, process documentation, user guides, training materials, job aids, and knowledge management resources.
* Partner with NHLBI stakeholders to identify operational challenges, evaluate opportunities, and recommend practical, mission-focused solutions.
* Analyze current-state business processes and develop future-state workflows that improve effectiveness, efficiency, compliance, and user experience.
* Provide strategic recommendations to program leadership regarding process improvements, system enhancements, operational performance, and organizational effectiveness.
* Support the development and implementation of tools, applications, and process improvements that enhance organizational performance.
* Lead business analysis activities including requirements elicitation, stakeholder engagement, process analysis, requirements management, and solution development.
* Support continuous improvement efforts across business processes, applications, reporting, and service delivery.
* Support application planning, backlog prioritization, roadmap development, and release planning efforts.
* Coordinate testing activities including functional testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect management, and production validation.
* Develop executive briefings, dashboards, presentations, demonstrations, and stakeholder communications.
* Lead knowledge transfer, onboarding, and transition activities to ensure continuity of operations and sustained success.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Health Sciences, Business or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in technical analysis, consulting, program support, or operational improvement roles.
* Experience supporting federal government programs or large, complex organizations.
* Demonstrated experience with Python and using similar tools to automate complex business processes.
* Demonstrated experience with budget analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to gather and translate business requirements into process improvements, system enhancements, and actionable recommendations.
* Experience developing SOPs, business process documentation, workflows, user guides, and training materials.
* Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into executive-level recommendations.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience supporting NIH, HHS, biomedical research, healthcare, public health, or scientific organizations.
* Experience supporting software development, application modernization, or digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience working within Agile environments.
* Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
* Experience with data analysis, reporting, dashboard development, and performance metrics.
* CBAP, PMI-PBA, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Scrum, or related certifications.

jobs.description:
**Description**

Are you an experienced analyst who thrives on tackling complex national security challenges where the answers aren’t always clear?

If so, we’re looking for someone like you to join our team in the National Security Analysis Department (NSAD) at JHU/APL.

NSAD is seeking experienced analysts with strong technical and analytic capabilities who can bring structure, rigor, and creativity to difficult problems at the intersection of adversary behavior, emerging technology, operational concepts, policy, and strategy.

In NSAD, we conduct independent, adversary-informed analysis that helps sharpen national security decision-making by defining what choices are available, what risks they carry, and what trade-offs they create. Our work is methodologically grounded and mission focused. We work across JHU/APL as integrators, helping to understand and articulate how technology fits into a larger operational, strategic, and policy context.

We are increasingly emphasizing data-driven analysis, intelligence-informed assessments, and the use of advanced analytic technologies, including Generative AI, to improve the speed, repeatability, transparency, and insightfulness of our work. We are looking for analysts who can deliver high-quality sponsor work today, while helping to modernize and innovate on the methods, workflows, and tools our analysts will need tomorrow.

The strongest candidates will combine analytic depth with breadth of perspective. We do not expect every analyst to be an expert in every method; we expect experienced analysts to understand the strengths and limitations of different approaches. We expect they are intellectually curious, comfortable with ambiguity, proactive in identifying and solving problems, and willing to learn new methods and technologies. Strong candidates will also be engaged and collaborative analysts who take ownership, identify what needs to be done, and work constructively across teams and disciplines to move complex efforts forward. We value analysts who can challenge ideas and assumptions while engaging colleagues with respect, intellectual humility, and a shared commitment to producing the best analysis.

**As an experienced Analyst in the National Security Analysis Department (NSAD), you will...**

* Lead and contribute to rigorous, data-driven national security analyses, looking across adversary capabilities and behavior, emerging technologies, operational concepts, policy implications, force structure, readiness, institutional capacity, and mission risk.
* Serve as an analytic integrator across technical, operational, intelligence, policy, and strategic perspectives, translating complex evidence into clear findings for sponsors and senior decision makers.
* Develop innovative analytic approaches to complex, ambiguous problems by framing key questions, identifying assumptions, defining measures of effectiveness, determining data requirements, evaluating uncertainty, and communicating defensible findings.
* Incorporate advanced analytic tools and methods into your work, including quantitative analysis, qualitative research, modeling and simulation, social science methodologies, and wargaming and tabletop exercises.
* Help build reusable analytic frameworks, datasets, baselines, and workflows that allow our analysts to assess evolving adversary capabilities, blue force options, technology impacts, and mission risks over time.
* Be an engaged member of multidisciplinary teams—to include technical experts and specialists—to identify what needs to be done, take ownership, seek out expertise and perspectives different from your own, and help colleagues solve problems and move work forward.
* Partner with JHU/APL program managers to shape work and engage directly with government sponsors and senior decision makers to understand their challenges, shape analytic questions, and present compelling results.
* Translate analytic results into clear insights for sponsor decisions and effectively communicate complex findings through briefings, reports, visualizations, and other products tailored to senior-leader audiences.
* Mentor junior analysts by helping them structure problems, apply sound methodology, evaluate evidence, communicate clearly, and develop as independent analytic contributors.

**You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...**

* Have a Master’s degree or higher in operations research, statistics, applied mathematics, the physical or social sciences, engineering, economics, or another analytically rigorous field.
* Have at least seven years of relevant experience supporting national security analysis or comparable mission-focused analytic work along with demonstrated analytic judgement, e.g., distinguishing important uncertainties from those on the periphery of the core issue; the ability to determine the elements of an ambiguous problem that matter most; the ability to quickly execute and adapt the approach as needed.
* Have demonstrated experience leading or substantially contributing to analyses of complex, unstructured problems.

jobs.description:
**Fleet Collaboration Industrial Placement**

* London based
* Salary: £66,500 – £70,000
* 5% bonus
* Additional allowance of £3,500 per annum
* Benefits package aligned to the role’s collective agreement

**Job Purpose / Overview**

The EPR Fleet Collaboration Project Manager reports directly to the Head of EPR Fleet Collaboration and is responsible for overseeing aspects of the EPR Fleet Collaboration programme scope. This position will work closely with HPC and SZC teams across the core functional areas and support the effective application of the HPC-SZC Collaboration Agreement on behalf of the Sizewell C Project.

The Project Manager will support the Head of EPR Fleet Collaboration with managing operations, incorporating lessons learned, and ensuring programme efficiency. The postholder will support the production of performance reports to the cross-project Collaboration Committee, offering oversight of activities and ensuring value delivery to both projects.

**Contextual Information**

Sizewell C’s business is to design, finance, construct, commission, operate, maintain and eventually decommission the nuclear power plant and related infrastructure at Sizewell C in Suffolk. Overall, whilst the Company is in the construction phase, the Boards’ principal focus is on the development and construction of Sizewell C on time, on budget and to the highest quality and safety standards. The Company is maturing to meet all these requirements.

Sizewell C is economically regulated by OFGEM under the RAB model similar to other UK electricity distribution networks and Thames Tideway.

Sizewell C construction strategy is to replicate the design of Hinkley Point C, using the majority of the same supply chain, but innovating in the way it is delivered to achieve savings in time and cost of around 20%. The CCO will need to be guided by and incorporate lessons learned from the Hinkley Point C commercial delivery to achieve Sizewell C’s ambition.

Following Financial Completion and Revenue Commencement, Sizewell C is fully funded and is owned by; The Secretary of State for Energy Security and Net Zero representing HM Government, La Caisse, Centrica, EDF and Amber Infrastructure

**Principal Accountabilities, Activities and Decisions**

jobs.title: Threat Intelligence Analyst, Threat Disruption
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Threat Disruption provides expert threat intelligence and conducts scaled operations against the adversaries attacking X. We investigate and disrupt threats across the following areas:

* Platform manipulation, including coordinated networks of bots attempting to pollute the information space
* Compromises of accounts owned by high-visibility individuals and organizations
* Sensitive allegations carrying reputational, legal, or geopolitical weight, including suspected foreign-linked influence campaigns
* Financial fraud, monetization abuse, and scam networks operating on and off X
* Other X Rules violations, including illegal activity and child safety

We identify how adversaries circumvent our defenses, abuse product features and core services, and benefit from the abuse. Based on these investigations, we conduct sweeps to disrupt immediate threats and provide recommendations to product, engineering, and policy teams to squash systemic vulnerabilities.

Where appropriate, Threat Disruption also coordinates with law enforcement and other external parties to enhance detections and support prosecution of bad actors.

Come help us defend the global town square.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Identify and counter sophisticated threat actors who are highly motivated to evade detection
* Conduct first-principles investigations into the threat surfaces outlined above
* Design and execute large-scale enforcement operations that remove hundreds of thousands to millions of adversary-controlled accounts
* Clearly and concisely communicate investigative findings and enforcement outcomes
* Partner closely with operations, engineering, product, and policy teams across the organization
* Rapidly and rigorously handle urgent incidents escalated by leadership

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Self-starter mindset with a proven ability to take initiative and drive work forward independently
* Deep commitment to analytical rigor and operational excellence
* Exceptional attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and adapt in a fast-paced environment
* Maturity and discretion when handling sensitive information, with the ability to remain calm and effective during urgent incidents
* Strong proficiency in SQL for querying large, complex datasets
* Comfort operating in the command line, writing scripts, and leveraging AI tools to amplify impact and scale work
* Flexibility to work across time zones, including weekends and holidays, as part of an on-call rotation
* Strong respect for users' freedom of speech and privacy

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience investigating platform manipulation, account compromise, influence operations, or fraud
* Experience turning investigations into production changes and enforcement outcomes
* Experience in a 24/7 on-call rotation, including owning urgent incidents and briefing leadership

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

jobs.description:
