Make this the place where *you* grow.

**Team leadership and delivery management**
-------------------------------------------

* Lead, allocate and coordinate the work of a threat intelligence team; set clear objectives, priorities, quality expectations and delivery deadlines.
* Provide technical supervision, peer review and escalation support while enabling analysts to exercise appropriate autonomy and judgement.
* Coach and mentor team members through structured feedback, knowledge sharing, skills development plans and support for professional certification.
* Manage workload, service risks, dependencies and competing client priorities; escalate material issues with clear options and recommendations.
* Establish and monitor delivery standards, analytical tradecraft, source handling, quality assurance and reusable intelligence processes.
* Act as deputy or workstream lead when required, representing the capability in client, operational and leadership forums.

**Threat intelligence direction, collection and analysis**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Define and maintain priority intelligence requirements and collection plans aligned to client assets, business exposure, threat scenarios and decision needs.
* Direct and conduct research across OSINT, commercial and government feeds, technical telemetry, malware reporting, trusted sharing communities, underground sources and other lawful intelligence sources.
* Analyse threat actors, campaigns, malware, infrastructure, indicators of compromise and tactics, techniques and procedures using structured analytical techniques.
* Assess source reliability, information credibility, confidence and intelligence gaps; distinguish verified reporting from analytical judgement.
* Produce strategic, operational and tactical intelligence explaining relevance, likely impact and recommended action rather than simply reproducing threat data.
* Maintain awareness of geopolitical, sector, regulatory and technology developments affecting UK and international clients.

**Intelligence production and stakeholder influence**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Own and assure executive threat briefs, campaign assessments, actor profiles, vulnerability intelligence, sector reports and incident intelligence packages.
* Brief senior leaders, clients, SOC teams, incident responders, detection engineers, vulnerability teams and risk stakeholders using language appropriate to each audience.
* Present defensible conclusions, confidence levels, assumptions, intelligence gaps and recommended actions; respond constructively to challenge and alternative hypotheses.
* Build trusted relationships with internal teams, clients, government bodies, industry groups and intelligence-sharing communities while protecting sensitive sources and information.

**Operational integration and capability improvement**
------------------------------------------------------

* Integrate intelligence into SIEM, SOAR, TIP, threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response and vulnerability prioritisation workflows.
* Guide the use of MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII, the intelligence cycle, Diamond Model and suitable analytical techniques.
* Develop and quality-assure correlation rules, watchlists, enrichment logic, automation and playbooks, with controls to limit false positives and unmanaged operational impact.
* Use lessons learned, stakeholder feedback and measurable outcomes to improve collection, analysis, dissemination and intelligence-led decisions.
* Support service development, proposals, client workshops and the evolution of NTT DATA threat intelligence methods and offerings.

* 3-5 years practical experience delivering cyber threat intelligence, including complex assessments and review of other analysts’ work.
* Demonstrable experience leading, coordinating or technically supervising a team, workstream or intelligence function and managing delivery through others.
* Strong knowledge of the intelligence cycle, structured analytical techniques, collection management, source evaluation, threat actor analysis and intelligence reporting.
* Deep working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and platforms such as MISP, ThreatConnect, Anomali or equivalent; practical experience of SIEM, SOAR and security operations integration.
* Ability to analyse malicious infrastructure, IOCs, malware reporting and TTPs, and explain how intelligence should change detection, response, hunting, vulnerability or risk decisions.
* Good understanding of OSINT and dark-web research, including legal, ethical, operational-security and source-protection considerations.
* Working capability in scripting or automation, preferably Python or PowerShell, and confidence working with APIs and structured intelligence formats.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive briefing, client engagement, analytical review and constructive challenge.

**Professional qualifications and development**
===============================================

Candidates should demonstrate knowledge and practical capability broadly consistent with CREST Registered Threat Intelligence Analyst level. Equivalent evidence from recognised training, certification and relevant operational experience will also be considered.

* Preferred: CREST Registered Threat Intelligence Analyst (CRTIA).
* Relevant alternatives or complement

* Development model: technical training, tooling and back-end (data lake / SQL) access provided by the Data & Analytics team and applied directly to Aviation work.

What You’ll Do

* Work with brokers and business stakeholders to understand real-world problems and translate them into data and AI questions.
* Explore and prototype data ideas, helping to shape user stories and analytical approaches.
* Clean, analyse and validate data from multiple sources — including premium and placement data, claims experience and underwriter / portfolio performance — to ensure accuracy and reliability.
* Spot patterns, trends and anomalies, and help explain what they mean in practice.
* Use modern data and analytics tools to turn raw data into clear, actionable outputs — reports, dashboards and analytics that support broker lineslips / facilities and senior management, both regular and ad-hoc.
* Support the use of AI-enabled tools to automate repetitive data entry, cleansing and reconciliation, and to accelerate the production of reports and analytics.
* Collaborate with data, technology and analytics teams across the wider group.
* Apply appropriate human review, document your work and follow best-practice data and AI standards. Break problems into steps an agent can execute, and use good judgement about when to lean on AI and when to do the work yourself.

What You’ll Grow Into

As you build aviation domain knowledge and technical depth, the role broadens to include:

* Acting as a data and analytics point of contact for the team’s lineslip portfolio — building and maintaining reporting suites covering bordereaux, income, claims and utilisation.
* Producing consolidated, portfolio-level analytics to support renewal strategy and market presentations.
* Identifying data-quality issues in lineslip records and working with brokers to resolve them at source.
* Acting as a business-analyst liaison between the broking team and IT / AI development resources — defining requirements, mapping workflows and setting data-capture standards.
* Participating in testing (UAT) and supporting brokers using AI-enabled tools: troubleshooting, onboarding users and maintaining guides and training materials.

What We’re Looking For

Essential

* A degree (or equivalent) in a numerate or analytical subject — e.g. maths, statistics, data science, economics, engineering or sciences.
* Strong attention to detail and logical thinking.
* A genuine interest in how data can influence business decisions.
* Confidence explaining ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* An inquisitive, problem-solving mindset — comfortable with modern AI tooling and keen to keep pace with a fast-moving landscape.

Technical skills (you don’t need all of these on day one)

* Experience using Excel for analysis.
* Exposure to Python, SQL and/or R through study, projects or internships.
* Familiarity with data-visualisation tools such as Power BI (or similar).
* Interest in learning modern data platforms (e.g. Databricks).
* Experience using GenAI / LLMs to support operational workflows and analytics.
* Any exposure to automation tools (e.g. Power Automate) and to producing presentation materials is an advantage.

Nice to have (but not required)

* University or personal projects involving real datasets.
* A basic understanding of data modelling or data pipelines.
* An interest in — or willingness to learn — insurance and aviation. Domain knowledge can be developed on the job.

Key Stakeholders

* Emma Roberts and the wider Aviation team.
* Aviation brokers and client executives.
* Markets / insurers (indirectly, through placement data and reporting).
* Central Data & Analytics team; IT / AI development teams.
* Operations teams.

How Success Will Be Measured

* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting.
* Quality and usefulness of data insights.
* Data quality and completeness across the aviation portfolio.
* Growing confidence and independence with the data platform and analytical too

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
### **Description**

As CFC continues to grow globally, we’re looking for an experienced **Business Analyst** to help shape and deliver strategic change across the business.  
  
You’ll work on a varied portfolio of initiatives spanning business transformation, operational improvement and regulatory change, partnering with stakeholders across areas such as underwriting, claims, operations, finance and compliance.  
  
This is a highly business-facing role where you’ll get under the skin of complex problems, challenge assumptions and help turn business needs into practical solutions that deliver measurable results. You’ll work closely with Project Managers, Product Owners, SMEs and delivery teams, helping ensure we’re solving the right problems rather than simply jumping to solutions.

  

### **About the role**

  

* Partner with stakeholders to understand business challenges, strategic objectives and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead workshops, interviews and discovery sessions to define problems, requirements, outcomes and success measures.
* Analyse existing processes, operating models and business capabilities, identifying opportunities to simplify and improve the way we work.
* Translate complex business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process maps and acceptance criteria.
* Design future-state processes and solutions, considering impacts across people, process, technology, data and controls.
* Challenge assumptions and provide evidence-based recommendations to support effective decision-making.
* Act as a key link between business stakeholders, Project Managers and delivery teams throughout the change lifecycle.
* Support solution evaluation, testing, UAT, business readiness and the successful adoption of new ways of working.
* Help measure the impact and benefits of change while contributing to the continued development of our Business Analysis capability.

  

### **About you**

  

* You’ll have proven experience as a **Business Analyst within insurance, specialty insurance, an MGA, broking or wider financial services**.
* You’ll bring a good understanding of insurance operations, ideally across areas such as underwriting, claims, delegated authority, policy administration, finance or regulatory compliance.
* You’re confident eliciting requirements, mapping processes and facilitating workshops with stakeholders at different levels.
* You have experience delivering business and operational change, ideally including insurance platform implementations.
* You’re comfortable working across Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.
* You’re naturally analytical and can break down complex problems into clear, practical and actionable solutions.
* You’re an engaging communicator who can build strong relationships, influence stakeholders and confidently challenge thinking when needed
* Knowledge of BPMN process modelling or business architecture techniques would be beneficial.

  

### **Core Values**

**Love what you do:**  
We show up each day ready to take on the world. Our passion and intensity set us apart and makes the difference to our colleagues, customers, brokers and carriers.  
  
**Challenge everything:**  
We’re never afraid to question the way that things are done and we constantly challenge ourselves and others to makes things better.  
  
**Have fun, be good:**  
Insurance is a serious business, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. We make it fun to work at CFC, we welcome all viewpoints, and we treat everyone how we would expect to be treated.

### **About CFC**

**Senior Technical Project Manager – AI Engineering**
=====================================================

**Department:** AI Engineering / Product Delivery  
**Position:** Senior Technical Project Manager (AI Engineering)

**About the Role**
------------------

We are seeking an exceptional **Senior Technical Project Manager with proven, hands-on AI engineering experience** to lead and accelerate our AI product roadmap from concept through production.

This is a high-impact leadership role that bridges **deep technical execution, strategic business objectives, and C-suite decision-making**. You will be responsible for transforming cutting-edge AI capabilities into scalable, reliable, production-grade enterprise solutions.

Unlike traditional project managers who primarily track tasks and timelines, you will bring genuine engineering expertise, strong technical judgment, and exceptional delivery discipline.

You will serve as a critical authority on **delivery quality, execution speed, technical rigor, and production readiness**, driving everything from project scoping and architectural trade-offs to statistical evaluation and successful deployment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. High-Velocity Delivery & Strategic Execution**

* **End-to-End Ownership:** Translate complex business objectives into actionable AI project roadmaps, clearly defined milestones, measurable outcomes, and quantifiable ROI targets.
* **Execution Excellence:** Establish clear accountability, rigorous acceptance criteria, realistic delivery baselines, and measurable performance standards to ensure consistent, on-time execution.
* **Dependency & Capacity Management:** Proactively eliminate engineering bottlenecks, coordinate cross-product dependencies, and optimize resource allocation across multidisciplinary teams.
* **Proactive Risk Management:** Identify technical, operational, and delivery risks early, drive rapid resolution, and present actionable mitigation strategies to executive leadership.
* **Scope & Change Governance:** Maintain disciplined change-control processes, ensuring scope adjustments are justified, documented, and aligned with business priorities and revised delivery commitments.

### **2. Technical Authority & Engineering Alignment**

* **Architecture & Feasibility Assessment:** Collaborate closely with AI engineering leads to evaluate model architectures, algorithms, infrastructure, and system designs against business and technical requirements.
* **Pragmatic Engineering Leadership:** Challenge unnecessary technical complexity, validate engineering estimates, and advocate for simpler, more reliable solutions when sophisticated AI approaches are not justified.
* **Strategic Trade-Off Analysis:** Guide technical decisions by evaluating model accuracy, inference latency, infrastructure cost, operational complexity, scalability, and system resilience.
* **Cross-Product Standardization:** Identify opportunities to reuse AI components, evaluation frameworks, engineering infrastructure, and architectural patterns across multiple products and teams.

### **3. Production Quality, Guardrails & Gatekeeping**

* **Rigorous Evaluation Frameworks:** Establish robust AI evaluation pipelines, representative benchmarks, statistical quality metrics, and measurable success criteria throughout the AI development lifecycle.
* **Production Readiness:** Enforce clear distinctions between proof-of-concept demonstrations, validated prototypes, and genuinely production-ready systems.
* **Evidence-Based Quality Gates:** Require measurable performance results, reproducible evaluations, and documented acceptance criteria before approving production releases.
* **Enterprise AI Guardrails:** Ensure appropriate fail-safes, real-time monitoring, human-in-the-loop escalation mechanisms, security controls, and operational fallback strategies are incorporated into delivery plans.

### **4. Executive Visibility & Strategic Alignment**

* **Evidence-Based Progress Tracking:** Validate project progress through tangible engineering evidence, including deployment logs, evaluation results, working demonstrations, and production performance metrics.
* **C-Suite Communication:** Act as the single source of truth for executive stakeholders, translating complex technical challenges into clear business risks, strategic options, and actionable decisions.
* **ROI-Driven Prioritization:** Continuously challenge scope creep, duplicated engineering efforts, and low-value initiatives to maximize business impact and engineering efficiency.
* **Strategic Accountability:** Maintain transparent reporting on milestones, dependencies, delivery confidence, resource requirements, and key technical decisions.

### **5. Process Optimization & Delivery Standardization**

* **Operational Excellence:** Define and enforce robust Definitions of Ready (DoR), Definitions of Done (DoD), quality gates, and production deployment standards.
* **Efficient Delivery Practices:** Lead focused planning sessions, technical risk reviews, milestone demonstrations, and decision-making forums that accelerate delivery without unnecessary administrative overhead.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring delivery inefficiencies and implement scalable processes that improve engineering productivity, predictability, and product quality.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**
----------------------------------------

* **Proven Delivery Track Record:** Extensive experience as a Senior Technical Project Manager, Technical Program Manager, or Engineering Leader delivering complex, high-value, multimillion-dollar software initiatives.
* **Hands-On AI Engineering Experience:** Demonstrable experience building, fine-tuning, evaluating, and deploying production AI/ML models, extending well beyond basic prompting or third-party API integrations.
* **Strong Technical Leadership:** Proven ability to challenge engineering assumptions, assess technical

jobs.title: Sr. Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Senior Data Analyst will leverage data analysis, statistical methods, and business intelligence tools to help drive strategic decision-making and improve operational efficiency. Involves analyzing data, providing actionable insights, and supporting various departments of Alignment Health.

1. Analyzes large datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights related to healthcare claims, member behavior, utilization, costs, and other key performance metrics.  
2. Designs and develops comprehensive reports and dashboards using business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) to communicate findings to key stakeholders.  
3. Performs statistical analysis and predictive modeling to inform business decisions, identify opportunities for cost savings, and improve outcomes.  
4. Presents actionable insights to senior management and cross-functional teams in a clear and concise manner.  
5. Monitors and ensures the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of healthcare data used for analysis and reporting.  
6. Develops and implements data validation processes to ensure data integrity and reliability.  
7. Assists in the development of data governance standards and practices to support regulatory and compliance requirements.  
8. Works with various Alignment departments including Provider Contracting and Network Development staff to analyze contract rate trending impact and anomalies.  
9. Identify opportunities to improve data analysis processes, tools, and techniques to enhance productivity and accuracy.  
10. Stay current with industry trends, data analytics technologies, and healthcare regulations to continuously improve data-driven decision-making within the organization.  
11. Supports finance and operations in developing predictive KPI’s to better forecast and manage the business of Alignment.  
12. Other projects and duties as assigned.

  + Ability to communicate positively, professionally and effectively with others; provide leadership, teach and collaborate with others.
  + Effective written and oral communication skills; ability to establish and maintain a constructive relationship with diverse members, management, employees and vendors;
  + Mathematical Skills: Ability to perform mathematical calculations and calculate simple statistics correctly
  + Reasoning Skills: Ability to prioritize multiple tasks; advanced problem-solving; ability to use advanced reasoning to define problems, collect data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and design, implement and manage appropriate resolution.
  + Problem-Solving Skills: Effective problem solving, organizational and time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  + Report Analysis Skills: Comprehend and analyze statistical reports.

**Licensure:**

jobs.description:
The Senior Principal Research Analyst in Regulatory Operations Analytics is responsible for the planning and execution of analytics projects throughout their lifecycle. This includes defining the approach, having the ability to scope and drive analytics with the appropriate quantitative methods, and working closely with the business to ensure project objectives and goals are met. This role works across the business to promote the use of advanced analytics to solve business problems.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* Promote the use of advanced analytics and associated insights for the consumption of internal and external stakeholders, including senior level management across the organization.
* Leads business engagement activities including soliciting use cases, user feedback, training, etc.
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of FINRA’s cross-market surveillance program.
* Work across delivery teams to deliver analytics capabilities that solve critical business problems.
* Drive availability of relevant data, tools, and infrastructure to facilitate for experimental and development purposes.
* Provide analytics-based research and respond to ad hoc requests in support of business objectives.
* Define approach for data collection for building analytics-based systems, transformations and extending company’s data with third party sources of information when needed.
* Devise and implement methods for automation of all parts of the predictive pipeline to achieve regulatory efficiencies.
* Actively participate in the completion of the enterprise-wide strategic plan for expanding analytics capabilities that support regulatory programs to improve efficiency and effectiveness.

* Demonstration of FINRA’s values.
* Collaboration, both in-person and virtually, in furtherance of FINRA’s mission of investor protection and market integrity.

**Other Responsibilities:**

* Mentor other Research Analysts on the team and within FINRA on methodologies and best practices.
* Maintain essential skills by attending training programs, associated conferences, and continued education in advanced analytics, software development, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

* Bachelor’s degree in STEM, Business, or similar quantitative discipline, and six (6) or more years of related work experience in Data Science, Engineering or Software development; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

* Familiarity with Big Data processing and platforms desirable
* Strong knowledge in at least one of the following programming languages: Python, R, SQL, or SCALA.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills

* Ability to work independently on complex and prolonged projects

jobs.title: Consultant - Data Analyst/BI Project Leader – Pharmacovigilance H/F
jobs.description:
Vous avez un profil solide en **Analyse de données et Business Intelligence appliqué à la santé**, une expertise confirmée en **manipulation de données (SQL, Alteryx) ainsi qu'en Pharmacovigilance**, et souhaitez intégrer une structure dynamique au cœur de l'innovation en Life Sciences ? Rejoignez-nous !

Poste basé à Paris.

#### **Vos missions**

Au sein des équipes d'IVIDATA Life Sciences et en collaboration avec nos clients issus des secteurs pharmaceutique et biotechnologique, vous interviendrez sur des projets à forte valeur ajoutée, en tant que **Data Analyst/BI Project Leader – Pharmacovigilance** pour :

* Extraire, nettoyer et customiser les données brutes issues des bases de sécurité et de vigilances
* Concevoir et exécuter des requêtes complexes en SQL ainsi que des flux de préparation de données sous Alteryx
* Exploiter les environnements Argus Safety et OAS pour répondre aux besoins d'analyses décisionnelles de la Pharmacovigilance
* Contribuer au suivi et à la production des livrables réglementaires de Pharmacovigilance (rapports périodiques, Case Management)
* Concevoir, modéliser et maintenir des tableaux de bord et outils de Data Visualization adaptés aux équipes métiers
* Assurer le rôle d’interface clé et de pilotage de projet BI en direct avec les équipes clientes et les Safety Officers
* Accompagner le client dans l'optimisation continue du traitement de ses données de santé et de sécurité

#### **Votre profil**

* **Formation :** Formation scientifique/santé (ex: Toxicologie, Pharmacie) avec une expérience en IT/Data, ou Master/Diplôme d'ingénieur en Informatique Décisionnelle/BI
* **Niveau d'expérience :** Entre 5 et 10 ans d'expérience au global, dont une expérience significative sur les processus et systèmes de Pharmacovigilance
* **Compétences techniques :** Capacités solides à coder en SQL, maîtrise d'Alteryx, connaissance de la base Argus Safety et d'OAS (Oracle Analytics Server), outils de Data Visualization (Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio...)
* **Environnement :** Connaissance approfondie du secteur Pharmaceutique ou de la Santé, de la réglementation et du process PV (rapports périodiques, Case Management)
* **Savoir être :** Excellentes capacités relationnelles pour travailler en direct avec le client, rigueur scientifique, autonomie, esprit d'analyse et force de proposition
* **Langues :** Anglais courant requis

#### **Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**

Chez **IVIDATA Life Sciences**, nous plaçons l’expertise au cœur de nos actions.  
Aux côtés des grands acteurs du secteur (laboratoires pharmaceutiques, biotech, dispositifs médicaux, santé animale, cosmétique, nutrition…), nos consultants interviennent sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des produits : de la recherche préclinique à l’industrialisation.

Nos 160 consultants déploient leurs compétences dans cinq domaines clés :  
**Biométrie, Opérations cliniques, Affaires réglementaires, Pharmacovigilance, Assurance Qualité.**

En rejoignant notre équipe, vous évoluerez dans un environnement **stimulant, collaboratif et en constante évolution**, où vos idées et votre expertise auront un impact réel.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering- Applied AI
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**Team Bio:**

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.

Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise.

**Why This Role Matters:**

Enterprise leaders aren’t just experimenting with AI—they’re demanding outcomes. The next wave of adoption will be led by those who can move fast, deliver measurable value, and transform 1-off wins into repeatable success.

As a FDE Technical Program Manager, you operate on the frontlines of transformation. You will support ServiceNow’s cross-functional Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) teams in building and delivering intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve our customers’ most mission-critical challenges.

You'll work in a fast-paced environment as our FDE team partners with key strategic customers to accelerate time to value. You will provide a proactive, strategic perspective, manage customer relationships, and drive tactical execution from initial conception through FDE build development, delivery, and successful completion.

**Who You Are:**

You are a dynamic and innovative problem-solver who thrives in complex, fast-paced environments. You have a strong analytical mindset while still keeping focus on the bigger picture. You have a background managing SDLC processes while keeping a customer-first mentality. You have a passion for AI and scaling innovation. You excel at transforming ambiguity into clarity and have hands on experience driving projects/programs end to end.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Work seamlessly with software engineers, product managers, product designers, and customers, to deliver intelligent systems that address mission-critical challenges using AI.
* Collaborate directly with customers to co-innovate AI solutions tailored to their needs, acting as the first point of contact or escalation.
* Develop trusted relationships with key internal and external technology leaders and stakeholders to drive focus on the strategic build objectives and optimize build delivery - this includes supporting and holding resources accountable for their responsibilities within the build.
* Drive large scale, cross-functional, high visibility AI software development builds on condensed timelines.

* Anticipate and remove obstacles that slow down or prevent builds from delivering on objectives, especially on the AI/ML deployment front.
* Help manage risks, dependencies and escalate impediments, as well as releases and navigating AI release requirements.
* Drive process improvements and create documentation to promote best practices using automation to replace repeatable, operational tasks.
* Coordinate day to day activities required to deliver a great solution on time, as well as create transparency through reports, dashboards, and status updates.
* Seek to continuously grow by proactively seeking and embracing constructive feedback, as well as provide feedback to colleagues to encourage an open and collaborative culture .

  
**Qualifications**  

* 8+ years of project/program management experience in mid/large size software development companies.
* A solid understanding of SDLC and release management practices in cloud-based SaaS product organizations.
* Prior work delivering AI or intelligent workflow solutions at scale, with proven success in deploying AI solutions that delivered tangible customer impact.
* Familiarity with AI governance, compliance, and enterprise security practices
* This role includes occasional travel.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated competence in key AI/ML software engineering program management best practices: program planning, schedule construction and management; risk assessment & mitigation, dependency management, change management, and predictive metrics.
* Outstanding collaboration and communication skills - clearly communicate changes, requests, and deadlines to the teams and risks, status, progress, and decisions to a variety of audiences including executives.
* Passion for working with people in technical and innovative environments, with the ability to work well with many different types of personalities in various functions.
* Strong leadership and relationship building skills to influence and motivate without authority - masterful in the art of bringing people together.
* Strong facilitation skills to lead/drive a variety of build events, with a high regard for quality, drive for continuous improvement across the organization, and ability to keep the big picture in view.
* Experience deploying AI solutions to prod

* Experience developing and maintaining project plans, timelines, Kanban boards, Gantt charts, dashboards, workflow maps, action logs, and portfolio-tracking systems.

Statistical expertise, independent data analysis, statistical analysis plan authorship, and scientific leadership are not required for this role.  

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS\*:**

Occasional evening and weekend hours.

* Supplier management: qualification, scorecards, QBRs, corrective actions.

* Manufacturing & logistics fundamentals (MRP concepts, inventory, material flow).

* **Preferred Commodity Experience:**

* **Laser & Sensors** – optical, motion, temperature, pressure, and process sensors.

* **Solid State Batteries** – next-generation energy storage, cell chemistry, and qualification.

--------------------------------------

**6. Accountability & Execution Mindset**
-----------------------------------------

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Engineering Management, or an MBA.
* 10 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Deep knowledge of Google Plan of Record (gPOR) infrastructure topologies, Purdue model compliance, or advanced zero-trust network architectures.
* Practical understanding of SCADA architectures, Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), and Facilities Network Routing.
* Sound understanding of vendor management, OpEx/CapEx budgets, and headcount allocation.
* Proficient at solving problems lacking clear precedent, leveraging thought leadership to translate broad corporate mandates into tactical, repeatable projects for field teams.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Infrastructure Development and Delivery (ID2) team designs, builds and operates gigawatts of reliable, efficient, flexible data centers around the world. Our data centers are the foundation of all Google services and infrastructure, from classic servers and networking to bespoke storage and advanced AI hardware. Google data centers lead the industry in efficiency and carbon footprint, and regularly introduce innovative new technologies and approaches for the ideal data center portfolio.

Google's Data Center Operations (DCOps) team acts as the stewards of the physical infrastructure that powers the world’s information. We operate the mechanical, electrical, and control systems that keep our servers running 24/7/365.

Data Center Central Ops is the global operational governance, engineering support, and business operations team, supporting efficient growth and operation of Google’s data center fleet.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

CoreWeave is building the infrastructure that powers the next era of AI, at a pace and scale that demands operational excellence across every function. We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to join the CIO organization and drive programs that connect Data Center Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT. You'll deliver the systems, integrations, and workflows that support predictable site expansion, trusted operational data, and reliable execution across CoreWeave.

**About the Role**
------------------

You will lead technical programs within Data Center Operations and across the functions that support the data center lifecycle. Your scope will span data center infrastructure management (DCIM), telemetry, asset management, lifecycle platforms, and their dependencies on procurement, inventory, financial systems, and IT.

You will connect workstreams into integrated plans, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and drive accountability from discovery through rollout and stabilization. The Technical Program Manager owns the integrated execution plan, delivery cadence, dependency and risk management, and readiness coordination. Business owners and the DC PMO own business requirements, approvals, and change management; Product Management owns product scope and acceptance criteria; Engineering owns technical design, implementation, testing, and technical support. You will bring these owners together to deliver agreed outcomes.

You will lead programs across multiple teams and functions, including interconnected initiatives across sites. You will resolve competing priorities with senior stakeholders, manage critical paths across programs, and establish delivery mechanisms adopted by multiple teams.

**In this role, you will:**

* Own integrated delivery plans for programs spanning Data Center Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT, with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and measurable outcomes.
* Connect site expansion and operational technology initiatives with procurement, equipment availability, inventory and asset records, financial processes, and IT readiness. Identify gaps between functional plans and drive decisions before they affect delivery.
* Drive DCIM deployment and site onboarding programs, coordinating asset data readiness, integrations, vendor commitments, testing, and operational handoffs to improve onboarding predictability.
* Partner with Facilities, Engineering, Data teams, and suppliers to improve telemetry coverage and data quality. Track monitoring gaps, alerting issues, and remediation through closure.
* Lead asset-system migrations and legacy-tool retirement, coordinating data reconciliation, downstream dependencies, cutover and rollback plans, and clear exit criteria.
* Coordinate delivery across lifecycle platforms, construction milestone integrations, enterprise systems, and operational dashboards, ensuring workflow and data changes remain consistent across functions.
* Maintain a unified view of program commitments, critical paths, risks, and decisions. Run effective planning and execution cadences, keep owners accountable, and escalate conflicts with clear options and recommendations.
* Maintain traceability from approved business requirements and product acceptance criteria through implementation, testing, and launch readiness. Ensure decisions and sign-offs come from the accountable owners.
* Orchestrate business UAT, go-live readiness, and operational handoffs. Coordinate with the DC PMO on training and communications and with Engineering on hypercare and support readiness, accounting for live-site constraints.
* Track outcomes such as predictable site onboarding, trusted asset and telemetry data, reliable integrations, adoption, and issue resolution. Build reusable plans, dashboards, and playbooks that improve execution across CoreWeave.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You have demonstrated delivery experience with a complex systems implementation or migration involving integrations, data readiness, testing, and operational handoff.
* You have experience leading technical programs across multiple business functions and can connect operational needs, enterprise systems, and technical delivery.
* You have strong fundamentals in integrated planning, critical-path analysis, dependency management, risk tracking, resource coordination, and driving decisions to closure.
* You can interpret system diagrams, APIs, integrations, data flows, migration approaches, and testing dependencies.
* You are familiar with data center operations and their connections to procurement, inventory, asset lifecycle, financial processes, and IT systems.
* You have practical experience using Agile, Scrum, or Kanban to manage delivery, with tools such as Jira and Asana.
* You have proven stakeholder-management experience across operational leaders, technical teams, business system owners, and external vendors, including resolving conflicting commitments and priorities.
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including concise executive updates that connect progress, risks, and decisions to business outcomes.
* You have demonstrated experience resolving priorities across senior stakeholders, managing dependencies across multiple programs, and establishing operating mechanisms used beyond your immediate team.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with Sunbird or other DCIM platforms

jobs.title: Human Data - Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Human Data powers model training and evaluation by producing high-quality human-generated data at scale. This role focuses on the metrics, systems, and operating insights that help Human Data run efficiently—spanning workforce performance, capacity and allocation, operational process health, and decision-making support for cross-functional partners. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with strong quantitative skills and operational judgment, able to turn incomplete data into clear recommendations that improve throughput, quality, cost, and reliability. You will partner with operations leaders, engineering stakeholders, and enabling teams to identify problems, build operating systems, and drive improved planning decisions.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Perform analyses of Human Data operational metrics—such as capacity, utilization, quality, throughput, cycle time, cost efficiency, and workforce health—to uncover trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Build and maintain reporting, trackers, and dashboards that make core operating KPIs visible and actionable for managers and cross-functional partners.
* Develop and improve planning and forecasting views (e.g., demand signals, supply/capacity, staffing needs, or process volumes) that support proactive, informed decisions.
* Support allocation and operating tradeoffs by synthesizing operational and performance data into clear recommendations for who/what should move where.
* Design, document, and refine operational processes and escalation paths so recurring work - performance actions, staffing, handoffs, and similar flows - is consistent, measurable, and scalable.
* Identify data gaps and partner with stakeholders to improve data collection, hygiene, and definitions so analysis and operating systems remain reliable.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, engineering, recruiting, onboarding, finance, and other partners to integrate insights into hiring, staffing, performance management, and operational planning decisions.
* Deliver concise readouts and recommendations to stakeholders, translating analysis into business-oriented next steps and tradeoffs.
* Own ad-hoc research and special projects that improve Human Data operating leverage.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 1+ years of professional experience in business analytics, business operations, consulting, workforce/operations analysis, or growth/ops strategy
* 1+ years of experience building and owning analytical models, trackers, or operating systems in Excel / Google Sheets or equivalent

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
* Experience with forecasting, capacity planning, workforce analytics, or performance metrics
* Proficiency in statistical or analytical techniques (e.g., cohort analysis, regression, time-series, anomaly detection) in Python, R, or similar
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or modern BI workflows
* Background in high-growth tech, marketplace/staffing operations, data labeling, human-in-the-loop systems, or consulting environments
* Excellent communication skills, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
* Project management experience, including prioritizing work in fast-paced settings and driving process change with diverse stakeholders
* Comfort using modern AI tools to accelerate analysis and operational workflow design

### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Weekend work may be required.
* Travel to other SpaceXSI sites may be required.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$122,000 - $180,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

You will support payroll operations serving employees across departments and school sites by processing timesheets, coordinating benefit-related payments, and resolving payroll and pay-related inquiries. Your work directly supports employee trust, operational stability, and fiscal accountability. By applying strong analytical, organizational, and customer service skills, you help ensure payroll processes are consistent, compliant, and responsive to the needs of employees, departments, and school sites. You communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment, and thrive in a fast-paced environment where deadlines, compliance, and customer service are essential. You take pride in supporting employees and departments through reliable payroll and benefits processes.

**As a Program Analyst on the Payroll team (Fiscal Services Department), you will be responsible for (but not limited to):**

* Processing and reviewing employee timesheets for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
* Supporting payroll processing for certificated, classified, and hourly employees
* Processing and reconciling benefit-related payments and payroll deductions

* Researching and resolving payroll discrepancies, adjustments, and inquiries in a timely manner
* Collaborating with Human Resources, Finance, and school sites to ensure accurate employee pay and benefits information
* Ensuring compliance with district policies, collective bargaining agreements, and applicable local, state, and federal regulations
* Maintaining payroll records and documentation in accordance with audit and retention requirements
* Assisting with payroll reporting, data analysis, and reconciliation activities
* Supporting process improvement efforts to increase efficiency, accuracy, and consistency in payroll operations
* Contributing to a culture of service, accountability, and professionalism within the Payroll and Business Services teams

**What you need for this position:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field preferred)

* Experience processing payroll and/or supporting payroll functions in a large or complex organization
* Strong understanding of payroll processes, including timesheets, deductions, and compliance requirements
* Proficiency in using payroll systems, financial systems, or ERP systems
* Strong computer literacy, including Microsoft Excel for data tracking, analysis, and reporting

**SB 848 Child Safety & Employment Disclosure Requirement**

Effective January 1, 2026, in accordance with California Senate Bill 848 (School Employee Misconduct/Child Abuse Prevention Act), applicants for employment with San José Unified are subject to enhanced child safety, training, and employment disclosure requirements.

Under SB 848, schools are required to strengthen background vetting procedures and obtain employment history information related to allegations of egregious misconduct involving students. Former employers may be contacted to release records regarding substantiated findings of misconduct as permitted by law. Failure to provide complete and accurate information regarding prior educational employment or relevant misconduct findings may result in disqualification from the hiring process or withdrawal of an offer of employment.

SB 848 also expands mandated reporter requirements and requires annual child abuse prevention training for employees and certain volunteers by July 1, 2026. All employees must comply with district-adopted child safety policies, including procedures for supervising and protecting students.

San José Unified is committed to maintaining a safe and supportive learning environment for all students and will review all disclosures and employment records in accordance with state law.

When will you hear back from us: Within seven days of applying, we will inform you if you will be moving forward in our hiring process and share next steps. If there is a delayed response, feel free to reach out to us at classified@sjusd.org.

Where applicable, please also note which available location you are applying to.

jobs.title: Finance and Business Operations Manager (Analyst)
jobs.description:
**Title: Finance and Business Operations Manager Reporting to: COO**

**ABOUT ANELLO**

ANELLO is innovative hardware company serving both defense and commercial customers with advanced navigation technology based on silicon photonics technology based by over 50 patents. These highly technical products are manufactured through a combination of internal activities, suppliers, and contract manufacturers. The company also performs work under multiple government contracts. ANELLO is at series B stage, has strong growing revenue and operating as a profitable company.

ANELLO is seeking a experienced and hands-on **Finance &** **Business Operations Manager** to lead the company's accounting and finance function and serve as a strategic partner to the leadership team.

This is an individual contributor role with broad responsibility across accounting, financial operations, financial planning, forecasting, and strategic analysis. The successful candidate will work closely with external accounting firm to own the integrity and timeliness of the company's financial information. Through the creation of a wide variety of financial models, the successful candidate will help leadership understand the financial implications of business decisions and identify opportunities to improve profitability, cash utilization, and operational efficiency.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

*Financial Operations and External Vendor Oversight*

* Act as the primary corporate point-of-contact to manage an external CPA firm, driving accountability and ensuring highly accurate, timely monthly, quarterly, and year-end close process.
* Supervise and audit the external firm's execution of core transaction processing, including general ledger management, accounts payable/receivable cycles, payroll administration, bank reconciliations, and accruals.
* Partner with external tax advisors to coordinate all federal, state, and local compliance requirements, including sales/use tax tracking, annual corporate filings, R&D tax credits, and specialized corporate valuations (e.g., 409A).
* Continually refine internal data pipelines, financial procedures, and documentation to ensure seamless transfer of financial records between internal teams and the external accounting provider.

*Financial Modeling, Forecasting & Strategic Advisory*

* Revenue & Sales Forecasting: Develop dynamic, scenario-based forecasting models across the broader business to project sales pipelines, diverse revenue streams, product pricing sensitivities, and long-term growth velocity.
* Build, maintain, and continually optimize financial models analyzing manufacturing costs, bill of materials (BOM), supply chain logistics, inventory turnover, and cost of goods sold (COGS) to maximize margins.
* Translate intricate modeling data, variance analyses, and financial anomalies into executive summaries, presentations, and KPIs that directly assist leadership's decision-making.
* Run detailed sensitivity analyses and capital allocation models to forecast corporate cash runway, evaluate major operational expenditures (CapEx), and support strategic runway planning.

*Government Contracting & Compliance*

* Monitor and track contract costs, expenditures, and invoicing requirements associated with SBIR and other government contracts.
* Work closely with technical teams to monitor performance against government budgets and support external compliance reviews.

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Accounting, or related field.
* 5+ years of finance and accounting experience, or experience in an Assistant Controller, Finance Manager, or similar FinOps role.
* Demonstrated experience owning monthly close and financial reporting.
* Experience in financial modeling, forecasting, and analytical skills.
* Advanced spreadsheet skills and ability to build financial models from underlying business assumptions.
* Ability to effectively engage with external accounting firms, tax advisors, and other financial service providers.
* Solid understanding of cash flow, working capital, budgeting, and financial planning.
* Ability to analyze complex business issues and communicate financial implications
* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of broader business objectives.
* Ability to operate independently and effectively in a small, fast-moving organization.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in a technology, hardware, engineering, manufacturing, or startup environment.
* Experience with contract manufacturers, suppliers, inventory, and product costing.
* Experience developing pricing, profitability, cost-benefit, and capital allocation analyses.
* Experience supporting fundraising, company valuation, due diligence, M&A, or other strategic transactions.
* CPA, MBA, CFA, or other relevant professional qualifications.
* Experience scaling finance processes in a growing company.

Additional:

* Due to US Gov contracts in place, successful candidates will be US Citizens or US Perm Residents.

Description:

Community medicine is an emerging veterinary discipline focused on expanding access to care for animals and the people who love them. It draws on both shelter medicine and private practice and is organized around principles such as spectrum of care, protocolled medicine, and task-shifting. The field is growing quickly, but it has no shared, authoritative body of guidance.

The Community Veterinary Medicine Project is a collaborative, multi-institution project, housed at the SF SPCA. It will be the first comprehensive, freely available resource for the veterinary field. Over 18 months, an Editorial Leadership Council (ELC) of five veterinary leaders, led by SF SPCA CEO, Dr. Jennifer Scarlett, will work with a national cohort of subject matter expert authors to produce four connected resources:

* **Clinical Guidelines** for veterinarians practicing community medicine
* **An Operations Manual** for launching and running community clinics
* **Clinical Decision Tools** designed for use in the exam room
* **A Research Database**, developed with UC Davis

The work follows a formal governance process with conflict-of-interest disclosure, an AI use policy, external peer review, and review by a Strategic Advisory Council.

You'll own day-to-day delivery of the project: the plan, the timeline, the budget tracking, and the pipeline that moves more than two dozen chapters from first draft to publication. You'll always know where things stand and what's at risk, and you'll bring problems to the Executive Sponsor, Dr. Jennifer Scarlett, early, with options.

This role suits someone who enjoys order, notices when something is about to fall through the cracks, and communicates clearly and warmly with senior professionals. Most of the people you'll work with are senior veterinary leaders who don't report to you and are fitting this work around demanding clinical careers. You don't need a veterinary background, but you do need to be comfortable learning a specialized vocabulary and applying written standards consistently.

*Own Project Plan and Timeline*

* Build and maintain the master project plan and timeline across all four deliverables.
* Spot schedule risks early and bring recovery options to the Executive Sponsor.
* Approve routine deadline extensions within agreed limits and escalate larger changes.

* Keep records that meet funder and governance documentation requirements at all times.

*Run the Governance Process*

* Send author notifications and onboarding packets.
* Organize author orientation sessions, kickoff calls, and mid-point check-ins, including recordings for those who can't attend live.

*Track Manuscripts Through Review*

* Process travel reimbursements and contributor stipends according to budget and policy.

**It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!**

**Job Description:**

**OVERVIEW OF POSITION:**
-------------------------

The Program Manager, Risk Adjustment & Stars, serves as the connective link between Alpine's technical teams (coding, data, analytics, IT) and its operational and business stakeholders (leadership, quality, health plan operations) for risk adjustment and Star Ratings performance. This role translates technical details, such as data pipelines, coding logic, and CMS methodology, into operational plans, priorities, and decisions, while ensuring operational requirements and business goals are reflected back into the technical work. The role does not require direct provider-facing engagement.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES:**

### **Program Management**

* Owns the annual risk adjustment and Stars improvement program cycle, coordinating between technical teams and operational/business stakeholders across prospective and retrospective programs, visit-based campaigns, and gap closure workflows.
* Builds and manages program timelines and throughput; reports progress to Alpine leadership and health plan partners in clear, business-friendly terms.
* Leads cross-functional workgroups spanning coding/HCC teams, clinical quality, IT, and analytics, ensuring technical work stays aligned to operational priorities.
* Manages program-level documentation and requirements, translating between technical specifications and operational plans.

### **Risk Adjustment**

* Acts as the liaison between coding/data teams and operational stakeholders on HCC capture workflows, chart review pipelines, and gap identification, ensuring both sides understand priorities and constraints.
* Manages relationships with vendors, coordinating technical file exchange and integration needs with operational timelines and expectations.
* Monitors RAF score trends and performance results, working with analytics teams to interpret findings and translates them into operational action plans.
* Coordinates risk adjustment data submission accuracy and reconciliation (EDS), connecting technical issue resolution with business and health plan deadlines.
* Tracks HCC model version transitions (e.g., CMS-HCC V24/V28) and communicates their operational and financial impact to leadership and business teams.

### **Stars & Quality**

* Coordinates Alpine's Star Ratings strategy across HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, and medication adherence measures, connecting technical measure logic with operational execution.
* Partners with analytics teams to maintain measure-level performance tracking and cut-point modeling, translating results into operational priorities and gap closure plans.
* Serves as one point of contact for Alpine with health plan Stars/quality teams, bridging technical data exchange requirements with operational and contractual needs.

### **Analytics & Reporting**

* Partners with analytics and data teams to define KPIs and dashboards for RAF accuracy, coding gap closure rates, and Star measure performance, ensuring outputs are operationally useful.
* Translates CMS methodology updates (HCC model version changes, Star Ratings technical notes, measure weighting changes) for both technical teams (as specifications) and operational teams (as business impact).
* Helps identify and escalate data integrity issues across source systems (claims, EHR, supplemental data feeds), coordinating resolution between technical and operational owners.
* Presents performance results and program recommendations to Alpine executive leadership and payer partners.

### **Compliance & Governance**

* Ensures all program activities comply with CMS regulations, ICD-10-CM coding guidelines, and Alpine's compliance policies.
* Supports RADV audit readiness and health plan data validation requests, coordinating between technical teams pulling data and operational/compliance teams managing the response.

**EDUCATION:**

Bachelor's degree in health informatics, data analytics, healthcare administration, business, or related field (Master's preferred).

**EXPERIENCE:**

Five (5) to seven (7) years of experience in Medicare Advantage risk adjustment and/or Star Ratings/quality improvement, ideally within a value-based care (VBC) setting.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Risk Adjustment Coder (CRC) credential.
* Experience with value-based care, ACOs, or delegated risk arrangements.
* Familiarity with multiple health plan Stars/quality programs and data exchange requirements.
* PMP or similar certification.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES:**

* Working knowledge of CMS HCC risk adjustment models, RAF score methodology, EDS submission processes, and Star Ratings measure specifications.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with both technical teams (data, analytics, IT) and operational/business stakeholders, translating between the two.
* Proven program/project management experience managing cross-functional initiatives involving both technical and operational workstreams.
* Working proficiency in Excel required; familiarity with SQL, Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical and regulatory detail for operational and executive audiences.
* Skilled at translating between technical and operational audiences, comfortable in both worlds without needing to be a deep technical expert.
* Strong relationship management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Analytical and detail-oriented, able to interpret data and technical findings and turn them into operational plans.
* Adaptable to evolving CMS methodology and health plan requirements.

**Key Responsibilities and Outputs**

* Data Modeling & Migration: Lead the migration of legacy workflows from Alteryx to dbt, ensuring high-quality, documented, and tested data models that serve as a single source of truth.

* Stakeholder Collaboration & Translation: Act as the primary liaison between technical data structures and non-technical leaders. You will translate complex "data speak" into clear insights that highlight ROI and business impact.
* AI & Advanced Analytics: Actively explore and implement AI/LLM capabilities to enhance data discovery and predictive modeling. Collaborate with Product/Engineering to apply Machine Learning (SageMaker) to areas like churn prediction and lead scoring.

**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* The "Technical Translator": You can explain a join or a latent variable to a Sales Director in a way that makes sense for their quota.
* Impact-Focused: You don't just deliver data; you deliver the "so what?"
* AI Enthusiast: You stay up to date with the latest in LLMs and are constantly thinking about how to apply generative AI to analytics workflows.
* Curiosity & Ownership: You lead with questions and take pride in the "cleanliness" and architecture of your code.

  
**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering, or a related data role.
* dbt Expertise: Proven experience building and maintaining production-grade data models using dbt.
* Orchestration Tools: Hands-on experience with Dagster or Airflow.
* SQL & Data Warehousing: Advanced SQL skills and experience with Amazon Redshift (or Snowflake/BigQuery).
* BI Visualization: Experience building stakeholder-facing dashboards in Tableau.
* CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with Salesforce data structures.

**Preferred**

* Alteryx: Experience with Alteryx (highly beneficial for supporting our migration to dbt).
* AI/ML: Experience with Python and a strong interest (or portfolio) in LLM applications and Machine Learning (Amazon SageMaker).
* Advanced Tableau: Building advanced dashboards and experience with Tableau Online/Server.
* Data Modeling: Salesforce-specific data modeling experience.
* Big Data: Experience dealing with large (+1M rows) customer engagement datasets.

  
**Additional Information**

The **expected annual base salary range** for this position is: **$84,225/year** to **$140,375/year**. This position is bonus eligible / commission-based.

Actual compensation will be provided in writing at the time of offer, if extended, and is determined by work location and a range of other relevant factors, including but not limited to: experience, skills, degrees, licensures, certifications, and other job-related factors. **Total Rewards @ Turnitin**  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

Overview:

The Technical Program Manager (TPM) is the single accountable owner for delivering Kastle’s enterprise-platform programs and the complex, cross-functional technology work that runs alongside them. Reporting to the CIO, the TPM drives one unified plan, sequence, and cadence across every functional owner and implementation partner touching a program — from the ERP, CRM, CPQ, and HRIS rollouts through client integration deliveries.

Kastle’s Enterprise Technology Team is entering a concentrated window of platform work: a net-new ERP implementation, a CRM moving from selection into build, a live CPQ migration, and an HRIS improvement program. These programs have overlapping timelines, external implementation partners, and shared dependencies. The TPM is engaged at kickoff on any program that clears a defined complexity bar and stays accountable through go-live and into steady-state updates.

Responsibilities:

The programs you will own

**Platform**

**Scope of the work**

**ERP**

Net-new implementation with an external partner; migration off legacy financial systems; phased rollout across finance and operations.

**CRM**

Selection in final stages, moving directly into a net-new build and rollout; feeds downstream systems including CPQ.

**CPQ**

Live migration off the legacy platform (Expert Logic to Logik); parity work, experience enhancements, and Sales acceptance.

**HRIS**

Deployment of improvements and ongoing configuration and release management on the existing platform.

  
Qualifications:

These programs already intersect. For example, CPQ enhancement items are on hold pending CRM field definitions that the CRM program has not yet finalized. The TPM is the person who sequences dependencies like this deliberately, so they are planned rather than discovered late.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Enterprise platform delivery**
--------------------------------

* **Own deployment, configuration, and ongoing updates** across the enterprise platforms: ERP, CRM, CPQ, and HRIS, from kickoff through go-live and into steady-state release management.
* **Maintain a unified cross-program plan** and manage dependencies between platforms (for example, CPQ enhancements that depend on CRM field definitions) so they are sequenced deliberately.
* **Coordinate external implementation partners and internal functional owners** to a single plan, status, and risk view per program.
* **Run recurring cross-functional status reviews** across every owner on a given program, including vendors and partners.

**Client integration delivery**
-------------------------------

* **Own an end-to-end plan across client integration delivery** — install, integration, hardware, onboarding, and access — with a single point of accountability across workstreams.
* **Validate access as its own workstream** and confirm delivery-method and migration assumptions (for example, full export versus incremental) before they become execution risk.
* **Ensure source data and credential requirements are gathered before kickoff,** working from the scoping and requirements handed off by the paired Solutions Engineer function.

**Governance and risk**
-----------------------

* **Operationalize governance once adopted:** run RACI, rollback runbooks, and the Integration Review Board gate as live delivery mechanisms rather than paper artifacts.
* **Provide executive-ready reporting:** one authoritative status, risk, and dependency view per owned program, communicated directly to executive stakeholders and the CIO.

Other Eligibility Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 5+ years of technical program or project management delivering complex, cross-functional technology programs with multiple functional owners and external partners.
* Demonstrated experience owning enterprise software implementations end to end — one or more of ERP, CRM, HRIS, or CPQ — including partner management, configuration, data migration, and phased rollout.
* Track record as a single accountable owner sequencing dependencies across concurrent programs.
* Fluency with integration and identity/access concepts (provisioning, SCIM/Entra, data reconciliation) sufficient to challenge delivery-method, migration, and access assumptions early.
* Experience standing up and running delivery governance: RACI, status cadences, review/gate mechanisms, and rollback planning.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable driving reviews and reporting status directly to executive stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program-management credential.
* Direct experience implementing one or more of the platform categories on Kastle’s roadmap (ERP, CRM, CPQ, HRIS).
* Experience in physical security, IoT, hardware-plus-software, or managed-services delivery environments.
* Prior experience coordinating platform migrations and large data migrations across vendors.

**First-90-Day Success Measures**
=================================
