Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:  

* Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
* Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
* Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
* Sick Time: 40 hours/year (increased to 69 hours/year for Seattle) including 5 discretionary sick days per instance
* Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
* Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
* Holidays: 13 paid days per year

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Sunnyvale, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Austin, TX, USA; Addison, TX, USA; Kirkland, WA, USA; New York, NY, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Seattle, WA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* Certification in CSSA, GICSP, GRID, CISSP, or equivalent.
* 10 years of experience in program or project management.
* 7 years of experience in a leadership role.
* Experience in risk management, and domain authority in OT Cybersecurity.
* Experience automating legacy workflows and migrating legacy systems onto centrally managed virtualization platforms (e.g., Kubernetes).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Engineering Management, or an MBA.
* 10 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Deep knowledge of Google Plan of Record (gPOR) infrastructure topologies, Purdue model compliance, or advanced zero-trust network architectures.
* Practical understanding of SCADA architectures, Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), and Facilities Network Routing.
* Sound understanding of vendor management, OpEx/CapEx budgets, and headcount allocation.
* Proficient at solving problems lacking clear precedent, leveraging thought leadership to translate broad corporate mandates into tactical, repeatable projects for field teams.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Infrastructure Development and Delivery (ID2) team designs, builds and operates gigawatts of reliable, efficient, flexible data centers around the world. Our data centers are the foundation of all Google services and infrastructure, from classic servers and networking to bespoke storage and advanced AI hardware. Google data centers lead the industry in efficiency and carbon footprint, and regularly introduce innovative new technologies and approaches for the ideal data center portfolio.

Google's Data Center Operations (DCOps) team acts as the stewards of the physical infrastructure that powers the world’s information. We operate the mechanical, electrical, and control systems that keep our servers running 24/7/365.

Data Center Central Ops is the global operational governance, engineering support, and business operations team, supporting efficient growth and operation of Google’s data center fleet.

As the Senior Program Manager for Data Center Physical Infrastructure Controls Security (PhysICS) and OT Health, you will lead the strategic operational programs keeping Infrastructure Development and Delivery (ID2) power and cooling engines running safely, securely, and reliably 24x7. You will be a People Manager responsible for hiring, coaching, and developing a globally distributed team of senior Technical Program Managers, Program Managers, and Operations Engineers.

You will act as the principal strategic liaison between Central Operations, Plant Engineering, local site teams, and security governance organizations, including Compliance, Strategy, and Risk Management (CSRM), Operational Technology Security (OTS) and Cloud CISO Security Engineering (CCSE). Your mission is to define the strategic roadmap to verifiably reduce cybersecurity risk on mission-critical Infrastructure Controls Security (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT), effectively hardening standard OT environments against IT-based threats.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $236000 - $329000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Define, articulate, and execute the multi-year strategic roadmap for OT Health and PhysICS security hygiene, tailoring program priorities to anticipate emerging cybersecurity threats and business constraints.
* Manage, coach, and scale a high-performing, globally distributed team. Identify skill gaps, foster a culture, and enable community contributions across the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Direct programs auditing and monitoring data center OT equipment configurations, PLC updates, OTHP virtualization, and asset inventory completeness to proactively drive reliability and reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).
* Serve as the central operational custodian bridging communication pathways between upstream security and design teams (CCSE, CSRM) and downstream local operational stakeholders.
* Guide team through ambiguous, high-stakes, highly complex technical bottlenecks, leveraging data-driven insights to unblock migrations and maintain strict Security SLOs.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories

new_jobs.title: Human Data - Business Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to understand the universe and help expand humanity's knowledge and capabilities. We work across the full Super Intelligence stack: compute (Colossus supercomputers), models (Grok), and applications (Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X). We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

Human Data powers model training and evaluation by producing high-quality human-generated data at scale. This role focuses on the metrics, systems, and operating insights that help Human Data run efficiently—spanning workforce performance, capacity and allocation, operational process health, and decision-making support for cross-functional partners. Our ideal candidate is a proactive analyst with strong quantitative skills and operational judgment, able to turn incomplete data into clear recommendations that improve throughput, quality, cost, and reliability. You will partner with operations leaders, engineering stakeholders, and enabling teams to identify problems, build operating systems, and drive improved planning decisions.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Perform analyses of Human Data operational metrics—such as capacity, utilization, quality, throughput, cycle time, cost efficiency, and workforce health—to uncover trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Build and maintain reporting, trackers, and dashboards that make core operating KPIs visible and actionable for managers and cross-functional partners.
* Develop and improve planning and forecasting views (e.g., demand signals, supply/capacity, staffing needs, or process volumes) that support proactive, informed decisions.
* Support allocation and operating tradeoffs by synthesizing operational and performance data into clear recommendations for who/what should move where.
* Design, document, and refine operational processes and escalation paths so recurring work - performance actions, staffing, handoffs, and similar flows - is consistent, measurable, and scalable.
* Identify data gaps and partner with stakeholders to improve data collection, hygiene, and definitions so analysis and operating systems remain reliable.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, engineering, recruiting, onboarding, finance, and other partners to integrate insights into hiring, staffing, performance management, and operational planning decisions.
* Deliver concise readouts and recommendations to stakeholders, translating analysis into business-oriented next steps and tradeoffs.
* Own ad-hoc research and special projects that improve Human Data operating leverage.

### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree
* 1+ years of professional experience in business analytics, business operations, consulting, workforce/operations analysis, or growth/ops strategy
* 1+ years of experience building and owning analytical models, trackers, or operating systems in Excel / Google Sheets or equivalent

### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, economics, statistics, computer science, engineering, or a related quantitative field
* Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, window functions, and query optimization
* Experience with forecasting, capacity planning, workforce analytics, or performance metrics
* Proficiency in statistical or analytical techniques (e.g., cohort analysis, regression, time-series, anomaly detection) in Python, R, or similar
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI) or modern BI workflows
* Background in high-growth tech, marketplace/staffing operations, data labeling, human-in-the-loop systems, or consulting environments
* Excellent communication skills, with a track record of presenting insights to non-technical audiences and influencing cross-functional teams
* Project management experience, including prioritizing work in fast-paced settings and driving process change with diverse stakeholders
* Comfort using modern AI tools to accelerate analysis and operational workflow design

### **ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Weekend work may be required.
* Travel to other SpaceXSI sites may be required.

### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**

$122,000 - $180,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

*SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

new_jobs.title: GEOS Project & Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

KLA's Global Workplace Services (GWS) team is passionate about advancing our business goals and company culture by building workplace environments that foster teamwork, innovation and productivity. GWS is responsible for site improvements to support business needs, promoting a secure work environment, regulation compliance, safety protocol implementation, emergency preparedness and risk mitigation.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  

**GEOS Project Execution Support**

* Coordinate and track GEOS project deliverables across engineering workstreams including facility condition assessments, environmental assessments, metering/meter data strategy, document management system implementation, BMS/Instrumentation & Controls initiatives, and digital twin development
* Maintain GEOS-specific project schedules, milestone logs, and risk/issue trackers
* Support engineering leads by managing document flow, requirements, and cross-functional alignments tied specifically to GEOS programs
* Coordinate vendor engagement for GEOS projects, including meeting logistics, information requests, GEOS templates, and GEOS compliance items.
  

  

**GEOS SOW & Procurement Support**

* Draft and coordinate Statements of Work for GEOS engineering initiatives (FCA/EA, BMS upgrades, metering, modeling, etc.)
* Manage GEOS routing with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and EHS when required
* Maintain GEOS contract and SOW libraries in accordance with GEOS documentation standards
* Support creation of cost breakouts, scope briefs, and technical appendices for GEOS engineering reviews.
  

  

**GEOS Financial Tracking & Reporting**

* Track OpEx and CapEx forecasts across GEOS’ program portfolio
* Maintain GEOS spend dashboards and monthly executive-level summaries
* Work closely with GEOS leadership and Finance to manage accruals, reclasses, invoice verification, and cost categorization
* Support quarterly GEOS financial reviews, Strat planning cycles, and annual budget refreshes
  

  

**GEOS Operations & Governance Support**

* Track NDAs, vendor onboarding requirements, GEOS standard templates, and GEOS-related compliance documents
* Support governance for GEOS’ engineering standards and specification workflows, including folder stage-gates (Draft, GEOS Review, Cross-Functional Review, Final)
* Assist with consolidating GEOS data flows across Nuvolo, Vault, BMS, Watershed, and project deliverables.
  

  

**GEOS Systems & Tools (GEOS-Specific Use Cases)**

* SharePoint: GEOS project repositories, standardization folders, SOW libraries, engineering deliverables
* Excel: GEOS financial models, spend trackers, engineering matrices, FCA/EA data tables
* Power BI: GEOS dashboards for utilities, metering, project progress, and standards adoption
* Nuvolo: GEOS data validation for asset, room, and system records
* Autodesk Vault: Access and tracking for GEOS document control deliverables
* SAP: For GEOS SOWs, POs, and engineering vendor engagement only.
  

  

**Limited Administrative Support**

* Schedule GEOS meetings, workshops, or vendor sessions
* Prepare and distribute GEOS meeting notes and action logs
* Support administrative workflows specifically tied to GEOS engineering processes.
  

  

**Preferred Skills**

* Exposure to facilities engineering, building systems, utilities, or infrastructure
* Experience with project coordination or technical program support
* Interest in engineering standards, infrastructure planning, or ESG-aligned utilities work.
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelors degree or relevant work experience.
* Two (2) years managing multiple concurrent GEOS engineering workstreams
* High proficiency in Excel and comfort with handling data
* Ability to work across engineering, finance, procurement, and technical systems
* Excellent communication skills for coordinating complex engineering deliverables
* Strong attention to detail in technical and financial documentation.

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  
  

**Total Rewards**

Base Pay Range: $63,000.00 - $92,400.00 Annually
Primary Location: USA-CA-Milpitas-KLA

KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst II, Tech
new_jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Data Analyst to join the Mobility Customer Experience Analytics team and become a key player in shaping the future of our business! In this high-impact role, you will apply your strategic and analytical prowess to drive data-driven decisions across critical elements of our mobility ecosystem, with a specific focus on growth bets, new product launches, and airports and venues. You will leverage our broad suite of ETL and data automation tools to build lasting data infrastructure while nimbly finding immediate insights that improve the business. This is an opportunity to define our analytical priorities and own the North Star metrics that measure the success of our growth bets and new product launches.  
  
You will be at the forefront of shaping our customer support experience design and tracking its impact across both traditional and cutting-edge GenAI-powered support channels. By designing deep-dive analyses, unearthing invaluable insights, and collaborating cross-functionally, you will uncover opportunities to streamline our user-facing support experience and enhance the tech we use to deliver it, ultimately driving groundbreaking solutions and significant impact for both the business and our users.  
  
**What you'll do**

* Own North Star metrics and targets to measure and deliver against the Mobility Customer Experience strategy.
* Perform deep-dive analysis and drive business decisions by developing testable hypotheses and designing experiments that clearly quantify the impact of new product launches, growth bets, and airport/venue operations through rigorous ROI analysis.
* Evaluate and shape customer support design, establishing rigorous impact tracking across both traditional support workflows and GenAI-powered support experiences.
* Translate ambiguous questions into data-driven recommendations that identify opportunities to streamline the user-facing support experience and advocate for customer-first changes to our products, app features, and support policies.
* Create and manage intuitive, self-service data products, dashboards, and reporting frameworks to empower non-technical users, business leaders, and cross-functional partners.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of business performance and build compelling, executive-level communications to share strategic insights and influence senior leadership across the Mobility ecosystem.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Operations, and Finance teams to implement data-backed recommendations, execute root-cause analyses, and drive operational efficiency.
* Write complex SQL queries and leverage data modeling to extract, manipulate, and transform raw data into stable, "single source of truth" architectures.
* Use Python and modern LLM-powered coding tools for data transformation, automation, and model development, deepening the team's ability to rapidly draw actionable insights from complex datasets.
* Potentially lead junior analysts and play a leadership role in developing, standardizing, and elevating the team's analytical tools, frameworks, and processes.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field
* 3+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a within a similar role
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, R, and SQL with proven ability to write and understand complex queries

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience using LLM-based coding and analytics tools to drive business outcomes
* Advanced SQL skills.
* High technical proficiency in common analytics & reporting tools (e.g., Tableau, Google Data Studio, Google Sheets/Excel).
* Skill in building intuitive, self-service tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Streamlit) for non-technical users and business leaders.
* Experience in Python
* Experience working with customer support or customer insights.
* Advanced data analysis skills leading to actionable recommendations.
* Experience in leading high-visibility projects and influencing others in a cross-functional team environment
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex data insights to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Curious, self-directed, and impact-driven-you chase high-impact problems to deliver solutions.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and switching contexts in a fast-moving environment
* Experience in communicating with and presenting to senior leaders.
* Strong storytelling ability: Distilling exciting and hard-to-find insights into a compelling, concise data story.
* Comfort in working with ambiguity in a fast-paced environment
* Experience in data extraction, wrangling, and building pipelines.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Highly self-motivated, proactive, and able to drive projects independently.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Detail-oriented mindset, with a focus on accuracy, efficiency, and process standardization.

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $135,000 per year - USD $150,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $135,000 per year - USD $150,000 per year.
